acronymexpander.title: Acronym Expander
acronymexpander.description: Acronym Expander resolves acronyms and abbreviations into their full meanings, complete with subject categories and definitions. Submit any short term up to 20 characters to get matching expansions and explanations for each domain.

params.name: acronym
params.description: The acronym to expand (max 20 characters)

params.name: context
params.description: Optional context to help determine the correct meaning

acronymgenerator.title: Acronym Generator
acronymgenerator.description: Acronym Generator creates acronyms from phrases by extracting the first letter of each word. Input 'Application Programming Interface' and get 'API'.

params.name: text
params.description: The phrase to generate an acronym from (must contain at least 2 words)

acrostic.title: Acrostic Puzzle Generator
acrostic.description: Acrostic Puzzle Generator creates puzzles where the first letters of answer words spell out a hidden keyword.

params.name: word
params.description: The keyword to spell out, letters A-Z only (3-15 letters recommended, max 100)

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme: random, positive, nature, adventure, friendship, learning (any other value is rejected)

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

advice.title: Advice Generator
advice.description: Advice Generator supplies random pieces of advice on demand. Each response includes a unique advice identifier, the advice quote, and the language code.

agecalculator.title: Age Calculator
agecalculator.description: Age Calculator converts a date of birth into exact age broken down by years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, and seconds. It also provides the age in written words and a countdown to the next birthday.

params.name: dob
params.description: The date of birth to calculate the age from (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone used to interpret the date of birth and to determine "today" when computing the age

aircrafttypes.title: Aircraft Types
aircrafttypes.description: Aircraft Types returns the physical and operational characteristics of an aircraft type from its ICAO designator, such as B738 or A320, or by searching manufacturer and model. Each type comes with wingspan, length, tail height, maximum takeoff and landing weight, approach speed and category, airplane design group, ICAO wake turbulence category and FAA weight class, with metric conversions. Paid plans add airport planning geometry, RECAT wake categories and US registration and traffic counts.

params.name: icao
params.description: ICAO aircraft type designator, for example B738, A20N or C172. When given, the other search parameters are ignored

params.name: manufacturer
params.description: Manufacturer name or part of it, for example Boeing, Airbus or Cessna

params.name: model
params.description: Model name or part of it, for example 737, A320 or Citation. Marketing names such as E175, A321XLR and 737 MAX 8 resolve to their ICAO type

params.name: engineType
params.description: Only types with this engine class

params.name: wakeCategory
params.description: Only types in this ICAO wake turbulence category

params.name: engines
params.description: Only types with this number of engines

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of types to return, 1-50

airlinelookup.title: Airline Lookup
airlinelookup.description: Airline Lookup is an airline codes API that matches IATA codes and airline names to carrier profiles, returning the official title, callsign, registration country, whether the carrier is still operating, and low-cost status. Paid tiers add the country's ISO code, three-letter ICAO code lookups and carrier logo URLs.

params.name: iata
params.description: The IATA code of the airline for which you want to get the information (e.g., AA)

airportcodeconverter.title: Airport Code Converter
airportcodeconverter.description: Airport Code Converter is an IATA code API that converts between 3-letter IATA and 4-letter ICAO airport codes. Submit either identifier to receive the matching code, official airport name, city, state, and country code.

params.name: code
params.description: The airport code to convert (IATA: 3 letters, ICAO: 4 letters)

airportdistance.title: Airport Distance
airportdistance.description: Airport Distance calculates the great-circle distance between two airports, plus estimated travel time, using their 3-letter IATA codes. It provides route distance in miles and kilometers plus estimated flight duration.

params.name: iata1
params.description: The IATA code of the first airport (e.g. JFK); a city code such as NYC uses that city's primary airport

params.name: iata2
params.description: The IATA code of the second airport (e.g. LAX); a city code such as LON uses that city's primary airport

airports.title: Airports Lookup
airports.description: Airports Lookup resolves 3-letter IATA codes into official airport names, matching ICAO codes, cities, states, country codes and country names. Paid plans add ICAO code lookups, search by airport name or city, the nearest airports to a latitude and longitude, geographic coordinates, elevation, local timezones and the current UTC offset across more than 29,000 facilities.

params.name: iata
params.description: The IATA code of the airport for which you want to get the information (e.g., MCI). A metropolitan city code such as NYC or LON returns that city's airports

airquality.title: Air Quality
airquality.description: Air Quality is an air pollution API that reports particulate pollution levels and health recommendations for any city, or a US, UK or Canadian postal code. Look up PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations to check current air conditions; paid plans add ozone, toxic gases, EPA and DEFRA index scores, and an estimated 0-500 US AQI with its category and dominant pollutant.

params.name: city
params.description: The city name for which you want to get the air quality data (e.g., New York). A name shared by several places resolves to the best-known one (Delhi is Delhi, India); add a state, province or country after a comma to pick another (e.g., Portland, Maine or London, Ontario)

params.name: aqi
params.description: Include the estimated 0-500 US AQI, its category, the dominant pollutant and the index for each pollutant

anagramdetector.title: Anagram Detector
anagramdetector.description: Anagram Detector checks whether two words or phrases are anagrams of each other. Submit two strings to receive a true or false match verdict, cleaned comparison text, and character counts with options to ignore letter case, spaces, punctuation and accents.

params.name: text1
params.description: The first text to compare

params.name: text2
params.description: The second text to compare

params.name: ignorecase
params.description: Ignore case when comparing (default: true)

params.name: ignorespaces
params.description: Ignore spaces when comparing (default: true)

params.name: ignorepunctuation
params.description: Ignore punctuation and symbols when comparing, so Funeral! and Real fun. match (default: true)

params.name: ignoreaccents
params.description: Ignore accents and other diacritics when comparing, so résumé matches resume (default: true)

anagrampuzzle.title: Anagram Puzzle Generator
anagrampuzzle.description: Anagram Puzzle Generator creates word puzzles where players rearrange scrambled letters to form valid words, with optional hints.

params.name: word
params.description: Specific word to create anagram for (letters a-z only; accents are folded, digits, spaces and symbols return 400)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of puzzles

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

antonym.title: Antonym Finder
antonym.description: Antonym Finder is an antonym lookup API that finds words with opposite meanings along with their parts of speech across supported languages. Pass any term and an optional language code to receive an array of antonyms.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to get the antonyms for

params.name: language
params.description: Language to return the antonyms in. Defaults to English

articleideas.title: Article Ideas Generator
articleideas.description: Article Ideas Generator creates article ideas and headline angles for any supplied topic. Pass a keyword up to 50 characters to receive a list of suggested titles and the total idea count.

params.name: topic
params.description: The topic for which you want to generate article ideas (up to 50 characters)

ascii85encoder.title: ASCII85 Encoder
ascii85encoder.description: ASCII85 Encoder encodes text into Base85 strings or decodes existing ASCII85 payloads back to plain text. Each request returns the converted output with original and processed character counts, while paid plans add custom formats and compression ratios.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to encode

params.name: action
params.description: Action to perform

params.name: format
params.description: Output format

asnlookup.title: ASN Lookup
asnlookup.description: ASN Lookup resolves any Autonomous System Number to its registered organization name and numeric identifier. Paid plans add the registry handle, country code, and announced IP range statistics.

params.name: asn
params.description: The ASN you want to get information about, such as AS15169, AS 15169, ASN15169 or 15169

babynamegenerator.title: Baby Name Generator
babynamegenerator.description: Baby Name Generator suggests first and middle name combinations for boys and girls based on a selected gender. Paid plans can request multiple names at once and include child avatar images.

params.name: gender
params.description: The gender for the generated names

params.name: count
params.description: The number of names to generate

params.name: includeAvatar
params.description: Include an AI-generated child face avatar matching gender

backgroundremover.title: Background Remover
backgroundremover.description: Background Remover is an image background removal API. Upload a photo or send its URL and it returns a PNG with the background made transparent, or replaced with a solid color you choose.

params.name: bgColor
params.description: Optional hex color to fill the background with (e.g. #ffffff). Omit for a transparent background.

balancesheet.title: Balance Sheet
balancesheet.description: Balance Sheet is a stock balance sheet API that returns the statement of financial position for a US public company by ticker - assets, liabilities and shareholders' equity - straight from SEC filings: current assets, cash, receivables, current liabilities, equity and more. Paid plans add total assets and liabilities, long-term debt, and liquidity and leverage ratios like current ratio, quick ratio and debt-to-equity.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year to retrieve. Defaults to latest available. History covers only the quarters captured so far; a missing period answers 404 listing the available ones.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

banklookup.title: Bank Lookup
banklookup.description: Bank Lookup is a bank and credit union lookup API covering every FDIC-insured institution ever chartered and every federally insured credit union. Search by name, FDIC certificate, NCUA charter, routing number, SWIFT code, LEI, website domain or IBAN and get the status, headquarters, regulator and identifiers, while paid plans add the successor of merged charters, failure details, the LEI, assets, deposits, members and full branch lists.

params.name: name
params.description: Institution name or part of it; former and trade names match too

params.name: id
params.description: Our institution id, e.g. fdic-3511 or ncua-5536

params.name: fdicCert
params.description: FDIC certificate number

params.name: ncuaCharter
params.description: NCUA credit union charter number

params.name: routing
params.description: Nine-digit ABA routing number

params.name: swift
params.description: SWIFT/BIC code (8 or 11 characters); non-US codes answer from our SWIFT directory

params.name: lei
params.description: Legal Entity Identifier (20 characters)

params.name: domain
params.description: Website domain, URL or email address of the institution. Consumer domains of the largest banks (chase.com, citi.com, tdbank.com, schwab.com) resolve as well as the domain the regulator lists

params.name: iban
params.description: IBAN; names the bank where the IBAN carries a BIC-style bank code (GB, IE, NL and others)

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter US state of the headquarters, to narrow a name search

params.name: type
params.description: Narrow a name search to one institution type

params.name: status
params.description: active, inactive (merged, failed or closed) or any; any searches active institutions first and falls back to closed ones

params.name: country
params.description: Two-letter country code; a non-US country searches banks by name in our SWIFT directory

params.name: branches
params.description: Include the branch list for the first five institutions

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum institutions to return (1-50)

barcodegenerator.title: Barcode Generator
barcodegenerator.description: Barcode Generator creates downloadable barcode images from text or product codes in Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14, Codabar, MSI and other linear formats, with bar width, height and margin adjustable on paid plans. Each response provides a temporary image download link, the image size in pixels, file format, and expiration timestamp.

params.name: data
params.description: The data you want to generate a barcode from (string), up to 256 characters

params.name: type
params.description: The type of barcode you want to generate

params.name: lineColor
params.description: The color of the barcode (default: #000000)

params.name: backgroundColor
params.description: The background color of the barcode (default: #ffffff)

params.name: displayValue
params.description: Whether to display the value below the barcode (default: true)

params.name: barWidth
params.description: Width of the narrowest bar in pixels (default: 4)

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the bars in pixels (default: 40)

params.name: margin
params.description: Quiet-zone margin around the barcode in pixels (default: 10)

params.name: fontSize
params.description: Font size of the text label in pixels (default: 20)

params.name: textMargin
params.description: Space between the bars and the text label in pixels (default: 2)

barcodereader.title: Barcode Reader
barcodereader.description: Barcode Reader decodes 1D barcodes from an uploaded image or an image URL, including EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF, Codabar and GS1 DataBar. It returns the decoded value and the symbology. Paid plans add the GTIN, the barcode's orientation and corners, and every barcode found in the image.

base64.title: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
base64.description: Base64 Encoder/Decoder encodes plain text into Base64 and decodes encoded strings back to readable characters. Submit any string with an encode or decode action to receive the converted output, the original input, and character length.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

benchmarkrate.title: Benchmark Rate
benchmarkrate.description: Benchmark Rate retrieves current risk-free reference rates across major currencies, covering SOFR, SONIA, ESTR, TONA, and SARON. Pass a rate symbol to receive the latest percentage rate, effective date, currency, region, and daily change direction.

params.name: rate
params.description: The benchmark rate to retrieve

bible.title: Bible
bible.description: Bible retrieves scripture passages and verses across nine public-domain translations, including the modern Berean Standard Bible (BSB), KJV, ASV, YLT and Darby. Look up a book, chapter and verse range or a written reference like Jn 3:16-18, search for words and phrases, get a random verse or the verse of the day, and step to the previous or next passage.

params.name: book
params.description: The name of the book in the bible (e.g., Genesis). Abbreviations such as Gen, Ps, 1 Cor or Jn are accepted

params.name: version
params.description: The Bible translation version

params.name: chapter
params.description: The chapter number in the book

params.name: verse
params.description: The verse number in the chapter

params.name: verseEnd
params.description: Last verse of a range starting at verse (e.g., verse=16&verseEnd=18). A value past the end of the chapter returns the rest of it

bimivalidator.title: BIMI Record Validator
bimivalidator.description: BIMI Validator checks if a domain has a valid BIMI record published in DNS. BIMI enables domain owners to display verified logos in supported email clients.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to validate the BIMI record for

bingocardgenerator.title: Bingo Card Generator
bingocardgenerator.description: Bingo Card Generator is a bingo API that creates customizable bingo cards with random numbers as JSON, with HTML rendering and downloadable PNG images on paid plans.

params.name: size
params.description: Card size (3x3 to 10x10)

params.name: freeSpace
params.description: Include free space in center

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable bingo card image

binlookup.title: BIN Lookup
binlookup.description: BIN Lookup is a BIN checker API: send the first 6 to 8 digits of a payment card and get the card brand, type (debit or credit), issuing bank and country of issuance back as JSON. Check incoming cards at checkout before you charge them.

params.name: bin
params.description: The first 6 to 8 digits of the card number (BIN). A full card number is also accepted; only its first 8 digits are used

params.name: ip
params.description: Optional IP address of the customer paying with the card. When given, customerIp says which country the IP is in and whether it matches the country that issued the card

birthchart.title: Birth Chart
birthchart.description: Birth Chart calculates a tropical natal chart from a birth date, time and location. It returns the sun, moon and rising signs, the ascendant and midheaven, and each planet's sign, degree and retrograde flag. Paid plans add the 12 house cusps, each planet's house, the major aspects and the element and modality balance.

params.name: date
params.description: The birth date (YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD-YYYY; DD/MM/YYYY when the day is over 12 and month names such as June 15, 1990 also work), between 1700 and 2200

params.name: time
params.description: The local birth time: 24-hour HH:mm (09:05), H:mm (9:05), HH:mm:ss (seconds are ignored) or 12-hour (9:05 PM)

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the birthplace

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the birthplace (east positive)

params.name: timezone
params.description: An IANA timezone name (America/New_York) or a UTC offset (+05:30, -0400 or UTC+05:30). Looked up from the coordinates when omitted

params.name: houseSystem
params.description: The house system to use

birthstones.title: Birthstones
birthstones.description: Birthstones is a comprehensive lookup API for birthstone information. It returns detailed data about gemstones associated with each birth month, including the primary stone, alternate stones, colors, meanings, and zodiac associations.

params.name: month
params.description: The month number (1-12, leading zero allowed), full name, or abbreviation (Jan, Sept)

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin Price
bitcoin.description: Bitcoin Price fetches the current Bitcoin price, recent movement direction, and update timestamps in USD. Paid plans can quote across 172 currencies and add market cap, 24-hour volume, supply, all-time highs, 1-hour to 1-year changes, 30-day stats, and hourly and 30-day daily history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in. Prices of 1 or more round to 2 decimals; smaller ones (quoted in BTC or XAU) keep 6 significant digits

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

params.name: daily
params.description: Include the daily closing price, market cap and volume for the last 30 days

bluetoothlookup.title: Bluetooth Company Lookup
bluetoothlookup.description: Bluetooth Company Lookup allows you to identify Bluetooth device manufacturers by their Bluetooth SIG assigned company identifier. This helps identify the manufacturer of Bluetooth devices, beacons, and accessories.

params.name: companyid
params.description: The Bluetooth SIG company identifier (decimal or hex with 0x prefix). For example, 76 or 0x4C for Apple.

bmicalculator.title: BMI Calculator
bmicalculator.description: BMI Calculator is a BMI API that computes Body Mass Index, its category and the healthy weight range for a given height, plus BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate), TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure), calorie targets and macronutrient recommendations for fitness and health applications.

params.name: weight
params.description: Weight in kg (metric) or lbs (imperial)

params.name: height
params.description: Height in cm (metric) or inches (imperial). Values under 3 (metric) are read as metres and under 8 (imperial) as feet

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit system for weight and height

params.name: age
params.description: Age in years (required for BMR/TDEE calculations)

params.name: gender
params.description: Gender (required for BMR/TDEE calculations)

params.name: activityLevel
params.description: Activity level (required for TDEE/calorie calculations)

boggleboardgenerator.title: Boggle Board Generator
boggleboardgenerator.description: Boggle Board Generator creates random Boggle game boards with authentic dice configurations, HTML rendering, and downloadable PNG images.

params.name: size
params.description: Board size

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable board image

botdetector.title: Bot Detector
botdetector.description: Bot Detector analyzes user agent strings to identify bots, crawlers, and automated software. It matches against a database of known bots and adds heuristics that catch automated clients not in the database, returning the bot's category, reputation and a composite risk score. Useful for security, analytics, and access control.

params.name: ua
params.description: The user agent string to analyze (URL encoded)

params.name: ip
params.description: Optional IP the request came from. When the user agent claims to be a Google, Bing, OpenAI or Apple crawler, it is checked against that operator's published IP ranges

bucketlist.title: Bucket List
bucketlist.description: Bucket List supplies a random bucket list idea for life goals, travel aspirations, and personal adventures. Call the endpoint with no parameters to receive a single activity suggestion.

caaparser.title: CAA Record Parser
caaparser.description: CAA Record Parser analyzes DNS CAA records that specify which Certificate Authorities are authorized to issue certificates for a domain.

params.name: record
params.description: The CAA record string to parse. A full record set, such as dig output with one record per line, is accepted; the top-level fields describe the first record and records/policy cover all of them

callingcode.title: Country Calling Code
callingcode.description: Country Calling Code is a phone number country code API that looks up international dialing codes and official names from a two-letter ISO country code. It returns an array of calling prefixes, standard country identifiers and, on request, the country's exit and trunk prefixes, other regions sharing its code, valid number lengths and example numbers by line type.

params.name: country
params.description: The country: a 2 or 3 letter ISO code (e.g. FR or FRA; UK is read as GB), an IOC code (e.g. GER) or an English name (e.g. France)

params.name: dialing
params.description: Include the dialing block: the international prefix, and (paid plans) the national prefix, regions sharing the calling code, valid number lengths and example numbers

caloriesburned.title: Calories Burned
caloriesburned.description: Calories Burned estimates the energy any of 1,100+ activities uses, from running and cycling to gardening and office work. Search by name or Compendium code, pass body weight in kg or lb and a duration, and get calories per hour and in total with the MET value, its Compendium code and the intensity class. Personalise with age, sex and height or a measured RMR, or ask how long it takes to burn a calorie target.

params.name: activity
params.description: Activity to search for, e.g. running, biking, yoga or mowing lawn. Add a speed or pace (running 6 mph, cycling 25 km/h, running 9 min/mile) to get the entry for that speed. Required unless code is given.

params.name: code
params.description: Five-digit Compendium activity code to look up directly, e.g. 12150.

params.name: weight
params.description: Body weight in kg (metric) or lb (imperial). Defaults to 70 kg.

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit system for weight and height: metric (kg, cm) or imperial (lb, in). Defaults to metric.

params.name: duration
params.description: Duration of the activity in minutes (1-1440). Defaults to 60.

params.name: calories
params.description: Calorie target: adds minutesToBurn, the minutes each activity takes to burn this many kcal.

params.name: age
params.description: Age in years (18-120), for a personalised estimate with sex and height.

params.name: sex
params.description: Sex for the resting metabolic rate estimate, with age and height.

params.name: height
params.description: Height in cm (metric) or inches (imperial), with age and sex.

params.name: rmr
params.description: Measured resting metabolic rate in kcal per day (500-5000). Overrides age, sex and height.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of matching activities to return (1-25). Defaults to 5.

captchagenerator.title: Captcha Generator
captchagenerator.description: Captcha Generator creates a new captcha on every call: distorted characters or a simple math question as a GIF or PNG, with the answer to check on your server. Add audio=true for a spoken version, the accessible alternative for visitors who can't see the image.

params.name: type
params.description: text draws random characters; math draws an arithmetic question such as 7 + 4 = ? and the solution is the answer. length, charset and unambiguous apply to text only

params.name: length
params.description: Number of characters in the captcha (4-8) (text only)

params.name: charset
params.description: Characters to draw from: lowercase letters, uppercase letters, mixed-case letters, digits, or letters and digits (text only)

params.name: unambiguous
params.description: Leave out characters that are easy to misread: 0, O, o, 1, l, I, i and Q (text only)

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Distortion level. Harder levels add more rotation, warp, noise lines, background texture and a line through the text. For type=math it also sets the numbers: small additions and subtractions at easy, larger ones at medium, multiplication at hard. It does not change the audio; see audioNoise

params.name: width
params.description: Image width in pixels (100-400)

params.name: height
params.description: Image height in pixels (40-150)

params.name: format
params.description: Image format

params.name: color
params.description: Text color as a hex code (e.g. #1d3557). By default each character gets a random dark color

params.name: backgroundColor
params.description: Background color as a hex code (e.g. #ffffff)

params.name: audio
params.description: Also return a spoken WAV version of the same challenge in audioURL, for visitors who cannot see the image. Text captchas are read character by character; math questions are read aloud without the answer

params.name: audioNoise
params.description: Background noise in the audio, with audio=true: none (clearest, best for accessibility), low, medium or high. Higher levels make automated transcription harder and the audio harder to follow

params.name: inline
params.description: Return the image as a base64 data URI in dataURI (and the audio in audioDataURI) instead of storing them; downloadURL and audioURL are then null

carddeckshuffler.title: Card Deck Shuffler
carddeckshuffler.description: Card Deck Shuffler randomizes standard playing card decks using Fisher-Yates or riffle algorithms. Pass the deck count and optional jokers to get the full ordered cards with rank, suit, shorthand symbols, and the top card.

params.name: decks
params.description: Number of decks to shuffle

params.name: jokers
params.description: Include jokers in the deck

params.name: method
params.description: Shuffling method

cardgenerator.title: Test Card Generator
cardgenerator.description: Test Card Generator is a test credit card generator API: it creates card numbers that pass format and Luhn checksum validation, for testing checkout forms and payment UIs across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, JCB, Diners Club and UnionPay. They aren't real cards: no bank issued them, and they can't be charged or used to buy anything. Each card comes with a security code, expiration date, issuer and masked number, and the gateway option returns Stripe's or Braintree's own documented test cards instead.

params.name: brand
params.description: The brand of the card to generate

params.name: count
params.description: The number of test card numbers to generate

params.name: includeAvatar
params.description: Include an AI-generated face avatar for the card owner

params.name: gateway
params.description: Return this payment gateway's documented test cards instead of generated numbers. They trigger a known outcome in the gateway's test mode

params.name: scenario
params.description: With gateway: the outcome to test, such as success, declined, insufficient_funds, expired_card, incorrect_cvc, fraud or 3ds_required (Stripe). Decline scenarios are mostly Visa cards, so the brand is ignored when the gateway has none for it

cardvalidator.title: Card Validator
cardvalidator.description: Card Validator is a credit card number validator API: it checks whether a card number is valid, identifies the card brand, and flags risk. It runs the Luhn checksum, detects the scheme (Visa, Mastercard, Amex and more), returns the PCI-safe BIN and last 4 digits, flags known processor test cards, and returns a composite risk score.

params.name: number
params.description: The card number to validate, up to 19 digits; spaces or dashes between digit groups are accepted

carmodels.title: US Car Models
carmodels.description: US Car Models is a car make and model API for vehicles sold in the United States from 1984 to present. List models by make on any plan, while paid plans add year filters, trims, fuel economy (MPG), engine details, and transmission specifications.

params.name: make
params.description: The make (manufacturer) of the car (e.g., Toyota, Honda, Ford). Common nicknames such as Chevy, VW, Caddy and Land Rover/LR are accepted

params.name: year
params.description: Filter by year (1984-present)

params.name: model
params.description: Narrow to a model name (e.g., Camry)

params.name: trim
params.description: Narrow to a trim level (e.g., Hybrid)

cashflow.title: Cash Flow Statement

chinesezodiac.title: Chinese Zodiac
chinesezodiac.description: Chinese Zodiac returns the zodiac animal, element, and characteristics for any birth date. Accurately accounts for the Chinese lunar calendar - the zodiac year starts on Chinese New Year, not January 1st.

chucknorris.title: Chuck Norris Jokes
chucknorris.description: Chuck Norris Jokes delivers a random Chuck Norris joke on every request without requiring any query parameters. Each call returns plain joke text ready to display in bots, command-line interfaces, or entertainment feeds.

citieslookup.title: Cities Lookup
citieslookup.description: Cities Lookup is a city search API that searches about 135,000 cities worldwide by name to find country codes, population counts and city size classifications, with an optional country filter. params.name: city
params.description: The city name to look up (e.g., New York). Accents are optional (Zurich finds Zürich), common former and informal names work (Bombay, Saigon, NYC), and a trailing ", ST" or ", Country" narrows the match (Dallas, TX or London, Canada)

params.name: country
params.description: Two-letter ISO country code to restrict matches to one country (e.g., US)

cocktail.title: Cocktail Recipe
cocktail.description: Cocktail Recipe retrieves cocktail recipes by drink name or ingredient, providing measured ingredients, preparation instructions, and recommended glassware. Responses include serving categories and ingredient counts, with support for pulling random drinks.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the cocktail for which you want to get the recipe (e.g., martini). Spelling variants match: mai tai, old-fashioned, whisky sour, piña colada, aperol spritz

codedetector.title: Code Detector
codedetector.description: Code Detector identifies the programming language of any submitted code snippet. It returns the canonical language name, readable title, and standard file extension for the detected code.

params.name: code
params.description: The code snippet you want to detect the programming language of

coinflipper.title: Coin Flipper
coinflipper.description: Coin Flipper simulates random coin flips and records heads or tails outcomes with flip counts. Paid plans can simulate multiple flips per request and calculate percentages, streak lengths, and fairness indicators.

params.name: flips
params.description: Number of coins to flip

colorbrightness.title: Color Brightness Calculator
colorbrightness.description: Color Brightness Calculator checks hex color brightness to classify values as light, dark, or medium, returning RGB components. Paid plans add WCAG contrast ratios, luminance scores, and recommended text colors.

params.name: hex
params.description: Hex color value (with or without # prefix)

colorconverter.title: Color Converter
colorconverter.description: Color Converter translates color values across hex, RGB, CMYK, and named inputs into standard RGB formats and channel breakdowns. Paid plans expand output to include CMYK, HSL, ANSI 16-color codes, and recognized English color names.

params.name: hex
params.description: The color in hexadecimal format (e.g., FF0000). A leading # or 0x is accepted, and 8-digit hex with alpha (FF000080) returns the alpha separately

colornamefinder.title: Color Name Finder
colornamefinder.description: Color Name Finder matches any hex color code to its closest named CSS color. Send a hex value to get the matching color name, RGB coordinates, and an exact match flag.

params.name: hex
params.description: Hex color value (with or without # prefix)

params.name: closest
params.description: Number of closest color matches to return

colorpalette.title: Color Palette Generator
colorpalette.description: Color Palette Generator is a color palette API that builds a harmonious color scheme from one HEX base color. Every plan returns each color's HEX code, closest color name, a dark flag and a legible black or white text color; paid plans add RGB, HSL, WCAG contrast checks, CSS variables and a PNG of the palette.

params.name: color
params.description: The base color to generate the palette from (HEX format without #)

params.name: scheme
params.description: The color scheme type

params.name: variation

params.name: count
params.description: Caps how many colors are returned (1-16). Each scheme has its own ceiling and count cannot raise it - mono yields 4, contrast 8, triade and analogic 12, tetrade 16. params.description: Color spacing distance (0-1). Affects triade, tetrade, and analogic schemes

colorsimilarity.title: Color Similarity Calculator
colorsimilarity.description: Color Similarity Calculator measures color similarity between two hex values. It returns an overall similarity score, a categorical match rating, and RGB and HSL channel breakdowns, while paid plans add Delta E and color distance metrics.

params.name: color1

params.name: color2
params.description: Second hex color value (with or without # prefix)

commentgenerator.title: Comment Generator
commentgenerator.description: Comment Generator produces social media comments formatted for text or image posts across positive, negative, and neutral tones. Each request returns generated comment text with optional emoji support, while paid plans can request batches up to 10.

params.name: mode
params.description: The mode of comment generation

params.name: tone
params.description: The tone of the comments

params.name: count
params.description: The number of comments to generate (max 10)

params.name: emojis
params.description: Whether to include emojis in the comments

companylookup.title: Company Lookup
companylookup.description: Company Lookup matches stock tickers, CIK numbers, company names, or SIC codes with official SEC registration records. It returns legal entity names, trading exchanges, tax EINs, Standard Industrial Classification codes, and registered business addresses.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL). A secondary share class such as GOOG resolves to its company

companynamegenerator.title: Company Name Generator
companynamegenerator.description: Company Name Generator generates business name ideas from a seed keyword, returning a list of suggested brand names. Supply any industry or concept word to receive ready-made brand naming suggestions.

params.name: keyword

compliments.title: Compliment Generator
compliments.description: Compliment Generator creates unique, heartfelt compliments using template-based generation with extensive word banks. Perfect for apps, chatbots, or spreading positivity.

contactextractor.title: Contact Extractor
contactextractor.description: Contact Extractor scrapes public email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses from any web page URL. It tallies the findings and returns unique records found on the page.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to extract contact data from (a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com; https:// is assumed when no scheme is given)

params.description: Limits the number of found contact details found on the page. Set -1 for unlimited

contentfilter.title: Content Filter
contentfilter.description: Content Filter checks URLs against a comprehensive blocklist of 200,000+ domains categorized as ads-malware, fake news, gambling, adult content, or social media. params.name: url
params.description: The URL or domain to check

coordinatesaresea.title: Coordinates Are Sea
coordinatesaresea.description: Coordinates Are Sea checks whether a given latitude and longitude pair sits in the ocean or on land. Pass geographic coordinates to receive a boolean confirming if the location is in the sea.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the coordinates

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the coordinates

costliving.title: Cost of Living
costliving.description: Cost of Living is a cost of living API that returns price-level indices for US states and metropolitan areas, with the US average at 100. params.name: location
params.description: State name, state code (e.g., CA, NY), city name (e.g., Chicago, or Portland, ME) or 5-digit ZIP code (e.g., 78701).

counter.title: Cloud Counter
counter.description: Cloud Counter stores and updates persistent numeric counters by ID without needing a database. It tracks increments, decrements, and custom values while returning timestamps and number properties like parity and prime status.

params.name: id

countryborders.title: Country Borders
countryborders.description: Country Borders identifies adjacent nations by two-letter ISO country code. It returns the list of bordering countries along with region, subregion, and landlocked status.

params.name: country

countryboundaries.title: Country Boundaries
countryboundaries.description: Country Boundaries retrieves GeoJSON border outlines for any country by its two-letter ISO code. Each response includes the country name, geometry type, and boundary coordinate pairs ready for mapping layers.

params.name: country

params.description: Outline detail: low (default, simplified world-scale outlines), medium (Natural Earth 1:50m) or high (Natural Earth 1:10m, including small islands). Use high for maps zoomed to a country or point-in-country tests near borders and coasts. Any other value returns 400

countryflags.title: Country Flags
countryflags.description: Country Flags is a country flag API that fetches direct download URLs for national flag images using two-letter ISO country codes. Responses return the country name, ISO code, and image link, while paid plans can select SVG or PNG formats and shapes.

params.name: country

countrylanguages.title: Country Languages
countrylanguages.description: Country Languages lists official and commonly spoken languages for any country using its two-letter ISO code. It returns the common country name, formal official name, an array of recognized languages, and the total language count.

params.description: The Country 2 letter ISO code for which you want to get languages for data (e.g., ZW)

countrylookup.title: Country Lookup
countrylookup.description: Country Lookup matches any country name or ISO code to its official names, ISO 3166 codes, capitals, region, languages, and flag emoji. Paid plans add coordinates and major cities, and with details=true demonyms, land area and UN membership.

params.name: country
params.description: The country name or ISO code to look up (e.g., USA). Native names (Deutschland, España), dotted codes (U.S., U.K.) and England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland are accepted

params.name: majorcities

params.description: Set to true to add demonyms, land area in square kilometers, and UN membership to each country

countydata.title: County Data Lookup
countydata.description: County Data Lookup is a county lookup API that retrieves income, poverty rate, and life expectancy for any US county by state and county name, along with its FIPS code and time zone. params.name: state
params.description: The US state the county is in: a two-letter code (MO) or the full name (Missouri)

params.name: county
params.description: The name of the US county to get data about (e.g. Jackson). Accents, punctuation, spacing and St/Saint are ignored, so Prince Georges, De Kalb and Saint Louis City match

cpiinflation.title: CPI Inflation
cpiinflation.description: CPI Inflation provides monthly Consumer Price Index data broken down by category including food, housing, transportation, medical care, and more. Includes year-over-year and month-over-month inflation rates for each category, with three-month changes on paid plans.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM format for historical lookup. Omit for current data.

crongenerator.title: Cron Expression Generator
crongenerator.description: Cron Expression Generator converts natural language schedule text into standard five-field cron expressions. Submit phrases up to 200 characters to receive the matching cron syntax, with paid plans adding written explanations.

cronparser.title: Cron Expression Parser

csvtojson.title: CSV to JSON Converter

currencyconverter.title: Currency Converter

currencyrate.title: Currency Rate
currencyrate.description: Currency Rate returns one currency's live value in US dollars or any other base, across 170+ currencies, with its name, symbol and direction since yesterday. datecalculator.title: Date Calculator

diceroller.description: Dice Roller is a dice API that simulates RPG dice rolls using standard notation like 3d6 or 2d20 with optional modifiers. It outputs the individual die outcomes, die count, and the sum of all rolls.

didyoumean.title: Did You Mean

params.description: The longitude of the second location

dividends.title: Dividends

params.name: domain

params.name: selector
params.description: The DKIM selector to look up (the label before ._domainkey). When omitted, a list of common selectors is tried

dmarcvalidator.title: DMARC Validator
dmarcvalidator.description: DMARC Validator is a DMARC record validator API that checks the Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance (DMARC) record for a domain to ensure it is correctly configured.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to validate the DMARC record for

dndgenerator.title: D&D Generator
dndgenerator.description: D&D Generator creates random content for tabletop role-playing games including characters, NPCs, monsters, treasure, encounters, taverns, and quests.

dnspropagation.title: DNS Propagation Checker

params.name: domain

dogbreeds.title: Dog Breeds

params.name: breed

domainage.title: Domain Age

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to check if it is available

domainexpiration.title: Domain Expiration

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to check the expiration date of

dtclookup.title: DTC Lookup
dtclookup.description: DTC Lookup explains OBD-II diagnostic trouble codes such as P0301 or U0100. It returns the code's system and standard title, which warning light it turns on, and on paid plans the full description, likely causes ranked by likelihood, symptoms, repair difficulty, estimated cost and labor hours, and related codes. Carmaker-specific codes are covered for 32 makes.

params.name: code
params.description: The OBD-II trouble code: P, B, C or U followed by four characters, for example P0301, U0100 or P2BAC. A VAG (VW, Audi, SEAT, Skoda) 5-digit code in the OBD-II ranges is also accepted, for example 16684 for P0300

params.name: make
params.description: The vehicle make, for carmaker-specific codes, for example Ford, Chevrolet, Audi or Lexus. Brands that share a code list answer from it, so Audi, SEAT and Skoda use the Volkswagen list and Lexus uses Toyota's

params.name: lang
params.description: Language of the title, description, causes and symptoms of generic codes

duedatecalculator.title: Due Date Calculator
duedatecalculator.description: Due Date Calculator estimates pregnancy due dates using either last menstrual period or conception date, providing comprehensive pregnancy timeline information.

params.name: last_period
params.description: First day of last menstrual period (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: cycle_length
params.description: Average menstrual cycle length in days (default 28). The due date, conception date and milestones move by cycle_length minus 28 days (modified Naegele rule)

earnings.title: Earnings Report
earnings.description: Earnings Report returns a company's complete financial statements - income statement, balance sheet and cash flow together - in a single call from SEC filings, making it a one-stop earnings API for fundamental stock data. Look up by ticker or CIK; paid plans add calculated margins and year and quarter filters. For a single focused statement, see the Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and Financial Ratios APIs.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

earthquake.title: Worldwide Earthquakes
earthquake.description: Worldwide Earthquakes tracks global seismic activity recorded over the past hour. It delivers magnitudes, epicenter coordinates and depth, location names, tsunami warning flags, USGS event links and 24-hour activity summaries sourced from the USGS. Filter by minimum magnitude; paid plans list the past 24 hours, search around any point, and add 7- and 30-day counts, the month's largest quake and daily history.

params.name: period
params.description: Time window: hour (the past hour), day (the past 24 hours) or week (the past 7 days, refreshed every 3 hours)

params.name: minMagnitude
params.description: Only return earthquakes of at least this magnitude

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude to search around. With lon, returns only earthquakes within radius km, nearest first, each with distanceKm. Sending lat without lon (or lon without lat) returns 400

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude to search around (use with lat)

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius in kilometers around lat/lon. Outside the US the source lists mostly M4-4.5 and larger quakes, so a small radius there can return none even when smaller quakes were felt

params.name: daily
params.description: Include one row per UTC day for the last 30 days: event count, largest magnitude and M4.5+ count

emaildisposablechecker.title: Disposable Email Checker
emaildisposablechecker.description: Disposable Email Checker is a disposable email detection API that tests whether an email address belongs to a disposable or temp mail provider. Pass any email to get back the domain parsed from it and a true or false flag showing whether it is temporary. That also makes it a quick way to drop throwaway domains when you derive a company domain from a list of emails.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to check (e.g., support@myspace.com). Send this or domain

params.name: domain
params.description: A domain to check instead of a full address (e.g., mailinator.com). Send this or email

emailvalidator.title: Email Validator
emailvalidator.description: Email Validator is an email validation API that checks whether an address is well-formed, whether its domain can receive mail, and whether it is safe to accept. It validates the format, resolves MX records (including null MX and the A-record fallback), checks for SPF and DMARC, flags disposable, role and free-provider addresses, and returns a normalized address for spotting duplicates. Paid plans add a risk score, typo correction, the mail provider and what a role mailbox is for (support, billing, noreply and so on).

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to validate (e.g., support@myspace.com)

emoji.title: Emoji Lookup
emoji.description: Emoji Lookup searches emoji characters, tags, or categories to return descriptive names and classifications. Query by raw symbol, keyword tag, or category to inspect matching emoji glyphs, text descriptions, and categories.

params.name: emoji
params.description: The emoji for which you want to get the text representation (e.g., 🥳). A :shortcode: such as :smile: or a code point such as U+1F600 is also accepted

emojidecorator.title: Emoji Decorator
emojidecorator.description: Emoji Decorator inserts relevant emojis into plain text strings. Submit any sentence or passage to receive the complete string decorated with fitting emojis.

params.name: text
params.description: The text you want decorated with emojis

energyprices.title: Energy Prices
energyprices.description: Energy Prices returns the latest daily closing spot price for WTI and Brent crude, Henry Hub natural gas and US gasoline, diesel, heating oil, propane and jet fuel benchmarks, with the previous close, the daily change and the 52-week high and low. Convert to barrels, gallons, liters, MMBtu, therms or MWh, ask for several benchmarks at once, or pull a daily or weekly history.

params.name: benchmark
params.description: Benchmark to price, or a comma-separated list (paid plans), or all. Defaults to wti. Ids: wti, brent, henryhub, gasoline_nyh, gasoline_gulf, rbob_la, ulsd_nyh, ulsd_gulf, carbdiesel_la, heatingoil, propane, jetfuel. Common names work too: crude or oil (wti), natural gas, natgas or henry hub (henryhub), gasoline (gasoline_nyh), diesel or ulsd (ulsd_nyh), heating oil, jet fuel or kerosene (jetfuel).

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit to price per: barrel, gallon or liter for crude and refined products; mmbtu, therm or mwh for natural gas. Defaults to each benchmark's published unit.

params.name: date
params.description: Date to look up (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the close on that day, or the latest trading day before it. Omit for the latest close.

params.name: history
params.description: Include a price series ending at the returned date: daily closes or the last close of each week.

params.name: days
params.description: Calendar days of history to include (1-3650). Daily history allows up to 366. Defaults to 30.

entryrequirements.title: Travel Entry Requirements
entryrequirements.description: Travel Entry Requirements returns what a destination asks of a visitor's passport and health documents: how long the passport must stay valid and from when, and whether a yellow fever certificate is required. Paid plans add a passport check against your trip dates, the blank pages it needs, the Schengen 10-year issue rule, the current UK and US travel advisory levels and plain-English guidance for each rule.

params.name: destination
params.description: The destination country or territory: a two-letter ISO code such as TH, or an English name such as Thailand

params.name: arrivalDate
params.description: Trip arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD), for passportCheck

params.name: departureDate
params.description: Trip departure date (YYYY-MM-DD), for passportCheck

params.name: passportExpiry
params.description: The traveler's passport expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); passportCheck says whether it meets the destination's rule

ethereum.title: Ethereum Price
ethereum.description: Ethereum Price is an Ethereum price feed API that tracks the spot price and movement direction of Ethereum in US dollars. Paid plans add 172 currencies, market cap, 24-hour volume, supply, all-time highs, 1-hour to 1-year changes, 30-day stats, and hourly and 30-day daily history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in. Prices of 1 or more round to 2 decimals; smaller ones (quoted in BTC or XAU) keep 6 significant digits

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

params.name: daily
params.description: Include the daily closing price, market cap and volume for the last 30 days

evchargingstations.title: EV Charging Stations
evchargingstations.description: EV Charging Stations finds electric vehicle charging stations within a radius of a point, a ZIP or postal code, or a city, across the US and Canada, sorted by distance. Each station returns its address, coordinates, distance, status, access, network, Level 1, Level 2 and DC fast port counts and connector types. Filter by connector, network, charging level or fast charging only. Paid plans add charging power in kW, pricing, access hours, phone, facility type and open dates.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the search centre. Use lat and lon, a zip, or a city and state

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the search centre

params.name: zip
params.description: US ZIP code or Canadian postal code to search around

params.name: city
params.description: City to search around, with state

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code, with city

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius in kilometres, up to 80

params.name: connector
params.description: Only stations with one of these connectors, comma-separated: j1772, ccs, chademo, nacs, nema515, nema520, nema1450, mcs

params.name: network
params.description: Only stations on a network whose name contains this, for example Tesla, ChargePoint or Electrify America

params.name: level
params.description: Only stations with ports at this charging level

params.name: fastOnly
params.description: Only stations with DC fast charging

params.name: access
params.description: Public stations (default), private ones, or all

params.name: status
params.description: Open stations (default), planned, temporarily unavailable, or all

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of stations to return, 1-100

exchangerate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangerate.description: Exchange Rate looks up the conversion rate between two currency codes across 170+ currencies, with both currency names and the last-updated time. Paid plans add the inverse rate, the pair's 1-day to 1-year change, its 30-day high, low, average and volatility, past dates, and hourly and 30-day daily history.

params.name: currency1
params.description: The first currency you want to get the exchange rate for

params.name: currency2
params.description: The second currency you want to get the exchange rate for

params.name: date
params.description: Optional past date (YYYY-MM-DD) to use that day's closing rates instead of live rates. History runs from 1999-01-04 for about 30 major currencies and covers every supported currency from March 2024. A day with no rates, such as a weekend or holiday, uses the last close before it.

params.name: history
params.description: Include the pair's daily closing rate for the last 30 days

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include the pair's rate for each of the last 24 hours (live rates only, not with date)

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.description: Exercises filters movements by target muscle group, equipment, and exercise name, returning up to 5 matching exercises per request (alphabetical) with their force type and required gear. Paid plans add step-by-step instructions, difficulty levels, and movement mechanics.

params.name: muscle
params.description: The muscle group to get exercises for. Optional when name or equipment is given; everyday names abs, core, back, legs, arms, quads, hams, delts and pecs cover their muscle groups

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the exercise to get information about; hyphens, spaces and plurals don't matter (pull up, pull-up and pullups all match)

params.name: equipment
params.description: The equipment used for the exercise

facedetect.title: Face Detector
facedetect.description: Face Detector is a face detection API that analyzes an image and reports whether it contains human faces. Paid plans add the face count and bounding box coordinates with a confidence score for each detected face.

params.name: confidence
params.description: Minimum confidence threshold for face detection (0.1 to 1.0)

fibonaccigenerator.title: Fibonacci Generator
fibonaccigenerator.description: Fibonacci Generator computes Fibonacci numbers and sequences based on a target count or ceiling value. Each response provides the generated sequence starting from any position, total sum, step ratios, and a golden ratio approximation.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of Fibonacci numbers to generate

params.name: startfrom
params.description: Start from this position in the sequence

filesizeformatter.title: File Size Formatter
filesizeformatter.description: File Size Formatter converts raw byte counts into human-readable file size strings. Send a byte count with optional precision and unit settings to receive formatted labels, unit names, and scaled numeric values.

params.name: bytes
params.description: Number of bytes to format

params.name: unit
params.description: Specific target unit (optional, auto-selects best unit if not specified)

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal places (0-10)

params.name: standard
params.description: Standard to use: binary (1024) or decimal (1000)

fillintheblanks.title: Fill in the Blanks Generator
fillintheblanks.description: Fill in the Blanks Generator creates completion puzzles from idioms, proverbs, quotes, science facts, and geography trivia.

params.name: category
params.description: Puzzle category

params.name: count
params.description: Number of puzzles

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

filmography.title: Filmography
filmography.description: Filmography returns the films a person worked on, newest first, from their name or Wikidata id: each film's title, year and the person's roles in it, such as director and writer. Filter by role to get only the films someone directed or acted in. When several people share a name, the best-known comes first and the others are listed with a film they are known for. Covers the cast and crew of about 450,000 films.

params.name: name
params.description: Person name, e.g. Christopher Nolan. Use name or id

params.name: id
params.description: Wikidata id of the person, e.g. Q25191

params.name: role
params.description: Only films with this role

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum films to return (1-50)

financialratios.title: Financial Ratios
financialratios.description: Financial Ratios returns the key profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency and cash-flow ratios for a US public company by ticker - margins, ROE, ROA, current ratio, debt-to-equity, interest coverage, asset turnover, FCF margin and more - all computed from SEC filing data. On paid plans, valuation=true adds market cap, P/E, P/S, P/B and earnings yield against the latest stored share price.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year to retrieve. Defaults to latest available. History covers only the quarters captured so far; a missing period answers 404 listing the available ones.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

params.name: valuation
params.description: Add a valuation block: market cap, P/E, earnings yield, P/S and P/B against the latest stored share price, with the trailing-twelve-month EPS, revenue and net income behind them. Latest filing only; null for a year/quarter request. The block is paid; free plans get it back null.

fortunecookie.title: Fortune Cookie Generator
fortunecookie.description: Fortune Cookie Generator creates authentic fortune cookie messages including wisdom, predictions, advice, humor, and motivational quotes.

params.name: type
params.description: Optional fortune type: wisdom, prediction, advice, humor or motivational (case-insensitive); omitted or unrecognised picks a type at random

fortuneteller.title: Fortune Teller
fortuneteller.description: Fortune Teller uses AI to generate personalized mystical fortunes across multiple categories including love, career, health, wealth, and travel.

params.name: category
params.description: Fortune category

params.name: question
params.description: Optional question for personalized fortune (max 500 characters)
params.example: What does the future hold for me?

fullyqualifieddomain.title: Fully Qualified Domain
fullyqualifieddomain.description: Fully Qualified Domain resolves an IP address to its fully qualified domain name using reverse DNS PTR records. It returns the host FQDN, base domain, TLD, subdomain, and domain level count.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to get the fully qualified domain name of

gamecharacter.title: Game Character Generator
gamecharacter.description: Generate complete RPG-style characters with race, class, background, stats, and personality.

params.name: race
params.description: Character race: Human, Elf, Dwarf, Halfling, Orc, Gnome, Tiefling, Dragonborn, Half-Elf, Goblin

params.name: class
params.description: Character class: Warrior, Mage, Rogue, Cleric, Ranger, Paladin, Barbarian, Bard, Druid, Monk, Warlock, Necromancer

gasprices.title: Gas Prices
gasprices.description: Gas Prices returns average retail gasoline, diesel and LPG prices from official weekly government surveys for the US, the UK, all 27 EU countries and the EU average. Pass a country, or a US state, region or city, to get the latest week with week-over-week and year-over-year changes, in any currency, per liter or per gallon.

params.name: country
params.description: Country to get prices for: US, GB (UK is accepted too), EU (the EU average) or any EU member code such as DE, FR or PL. English country names such as Germany are accepted too. Defaults to US. Countries other than US require a paid plan.

params.name: area
params.description: US only: any state as a code or full name (GA, Georgia), a region (eastcoast, newengland, centralatlantic, loweratlantic, midwest, gulfcoast, rockymountain, westcoast, westcoastexcalifornia) or a city (boston, chicago, cleveland, denver, houston, losangeles, miami, newyorkcity, sanfrancisco, seattle; spaces are fine). EIA publishes its own series for CA, CO, FL, MA, MN, NY, OH, TX and WA; any other state returns its PADD region average with resolvedFrom and a note. Omit for the national average. Requires a paid plan.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency to return prices in, as an ISO code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). Defaults to the country's own currency.

params.name: unit
params.description: Volume unit to price per: liter or gallon. Defaults to the source's unit (gallon for the US, liter elsewhere).

params.name: date
params.description: Date to look up (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the survey week in effect on that date. Omit for the latest week.

gdp.title: GDP Data
gdp.description: Get GDP (Gross Domestic Product) data for any country including current values and historical data going back to 1960. With changes=true it also returns the direction against the previous year, and on paid plans the prior year's GDP, the dollar and percent change, whether real growth is accelerating or slowing, and 5- and 10-year compound annual growth.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2 or 3-letter country code (e.g., US, USA, GB, GBR). UK and EL are accepted for GB and GR

params.name: year
params.description: Specific year to retrieve data for (1960-present). Returns latest if not specified.

params.name: changes
params.description: Include the change against the previous year, the growth trend, the 5-year average growth rate and the 5- and 10-year compound annual growth rates

genderdetector.title: Gender Detector
genderdetector.description: Gender Detector is a gender prediction API that estimates the likely gender of a person from their name. Pass a first name and get back the predicted gender as JSON, ready for salutations, profile defaults, or audience analysis.

params.name: name
params.description: The name for which you want to detect the gender

params.name: country
params.description: The country code for the name (e.g., US). Recorded and echoed back in the response, but detection does not yet vary by country - the same name returns the same gender whichever code you pass

gibberishdetector.title: Gibberish Detector
gibberishdetector.description: Gibberish Detector analyzes text using bigram frequency and vowel ratios to identify nonsensical or randomly generated content.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to analyze (max 10,000 characters)

globalstockmarket.title: Global Stock Market
globalstockmarket.description: Global Stock Market tracks share price indices across 36 countries using a normalized 2015 baseline. Send a two-letter country code to receive the latest monthly index value with the previous month's reading and direction, while paid plans add 1, 3, 6 and 12-month and year-to-date changes, the 12-month high, low and average, and the last 12 monthly readings.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2-letter country code. UK and EL are accepted for GB and GR

params.name: year
params.description: Year to retrieve data for (2000-present). Requires month parameter.

params.name: month
params.description: Month to retrieve data for (1-12). Required when year is specified.

params.name: history
params.description: Include the 12 monthly readings ending at the returned month

goldprice.title: Gold Price
goldprice.description: Gold Price fetches real-time spot gold prices per troy ounce, gram, and kilogram. Each response includes the update timestamp, 24-hour price change, and market direction, while paid plans add custom currencies, karat prices, 7- and 30-day changes, 30-day stats, and hourly and daily history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

params.name: daily
params.description: Include the daily closing price per ounce for the last 30 days

grammarcheck.title: Grammar Check
grammarcheck.description: Grammar Check is a grammar checker and spell check API for English text that inspects text for spelling and grammar errors, returning the corrected wording, error count, and a modified flag. Paid plans add detailed rule descriptions, character offsets, and suggestions for every detected mistake.

params.name: text
params.description: The English text you want to check for grammatical and spelling errors

gravatarlookup.title: Gravatar Lookup
gravatarlookup.description: Gravatar Lookup is a Gravatar API for email lookups: send an email address and get its public Gravatar profile and avatar image URL. It returns the display name, username, biography, location, company, job title and pronouns; paid plans add linked accounts (hidden ones flagged) and whether the email has its own uploaded avatar.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to lookup the Gravatar profile of

guidgenerator.title: GUID Generator
guidgenerator.description: GUID Generator is a GUID generator API that creates RFC 4122 version 4 GUIDs in standard, uppercase, hyphen-free, or brace-wrapped formats. Pass a count and formatting style to receive a batch of unique IDs matching your structural requirements.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of GUIDs to generate

params.name: format
params.description: Output format

hangmanword.title: Hangman Word Generator
hangmanword.description: Hangman Word Generator provides random hangman words for word games, with difficulty levels based on word length and, on paid plans, category filtering.

params.name: category
params.description: Word category

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty by letter count: easy is 6 letters or fewer, medium 5-9, hard 8 or more

params.name: count
params.description: Number of words

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

hardinesszone.title: USDA Hardiness Zone
hardinesszone.description: USDA Hardiness Zone looks up the plant hardiness zone by ZIP code, mapping any US ZIP code to its temperature range. Paid plans add the zone classification code and zone title, Celsius values, and plant survival recommendations.

params.name: zip
params.description: The US ZIP code to get the USDA Plant Hardiness Zone for. ZIP+4 (97201-1234) and ZIPs missing their leading zero (2134) are accepted

hashgenerator.title: Hash Generator
hashgenerator.description: Hash Generator computes cryptographic hashes for any text string across algorithms such as MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512, and BLAKE2. It outputs digests for single or multiple algorithms in one request.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to hash

params.name: algorithms
params.description: Comma-separated list of algorithms or 'all'

hashtaggenerator.title: Hashtag Generator
hashtaggenerator.description: Hashtag Generator creates relevant hashtags from any plain text or post caption. Pass in a text snippet to receive an array of suggested social tags, with paid plans able to customize the tag count.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to generate hashtags from

params.name: count
params.description: Number of hashtags to generate. 1 to 10)

heicconverter.title: HEIC Converter
heicconverter.description: HEIC Converter transforms Apple HEIC and HEIF images to web-friendly formats. Perfect for processing iPhone photos that need to be converted for websites, apps, or services that don't support HEIC.

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: Target format

params.name: quality
params.description: Output quality (applies to jpg/webp)

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum width in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Maximum height in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

historicalevents.title: Historical Events
historicalevents.description: Historical Events is a world history API that searches historical records by keyword to find matching events and their detailed descriptions. Paid plans add exact calendar dates and queries by year or date.

params.name: text
params.description: The keyword for which you want to get the historical events (e.g., moon landing)

hmac.title: HMAC Generator
hmac.description: HMAC Generator creates Hash-based Message Authentication Codes for data integrity and authentication. Supports SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-1, and MD5 algorithms.

params.name: message
params.description: The message to sign

params.name: secret
params.description: The secret key for HMAC generation

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Hash algorithm to use

params.name: encoding
params.description: Output encoding format

params.name: secretEncoding
params.description: How the secret is encoded. Use base64 for Svix / Standard Webhooks keys (a leading whsec_ is stripped) and hex for binary keys such as chained AWS SigV4 keys. Stripe and GitHub secrets are plain utf8, whsec_ prefix included

params.name: signature
params.description: Optional signature received with a webhook. When sent, the response adds matches (timing-safe compare in the chosen encoding). Prefixes like sha256=, v1, and Svix space-separated lists are accepted

horoscope.title: Horoscope
horoscope.description: Horoscope fetches daily horoscope readings and sign details for any of the twelve zodiac signs. Pass a sign name to receive today's forecast text; paid tiers add birthdate lookups, mood, lucky numbers, sign compatibility, and sign facts like the ruling planet, opposite sign, brightest star and days until the sign's season.

params.name: sign
params.description: The zodiac sign for which you want to get the horoscope

params.name: period
params.description: daily (default), weekly or monthly

htmlentities.title: HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder
htmlentities.description: HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder converts special characters into safe HTML entities or restores encoded strings back to standard text. Pass any HTML markup or text snippet to receive the converted string, a replacement count, and a list of modified characters.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML content to encode

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

htmltoimage.title: HTML to Image
htmltoimage.description: HTML to Image is an HTML to image API that renders HTML code into a high-quality PNG image. Paid plans add custom dimensions and JPEG or WebP output.

params.name: html
params.description: HTML code to convert

params.name: width
params.description: Image width in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Image height in pixels

params.name: format
params.description: Output image format

params.name: fullPage
params.description: Capture the whole page instead of cropping at the viewport height, so a long receipt, invoice or report comes back complete (default: false)

htmltopdf.title: HTML to PDF
htmltopdf.description: This HTML to PDF API renders raw HTML markup into downloadable PDF files. Send your escaped HTML string to receive a signed download link, an expiration timestamp, and the generated document filename.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML content to convert to PDF. Ensure that the HTML is escaped properly

params.name: marginTop
params.description: The top margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: marginRight
params.description: The right margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: marginBottom
params.description: The bottom margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: marginLeft
params.description: The left margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.5)

params.name: landscape
params.description: Set to true for landscape orientation

params.name: format
params.description: Paper size

params.name: scale
params.description: Zoom applied to the page content, 0.1 to 2

params.name: printBackground
params.description: Print background colours and images; set false for an ink-saving document

params.name: pageRanges
params.description: Only these pages, e.g. 1-3, 5

params.name: headerTemplate
params.description: HTML printed at the top of every page. Spans with class pageNumber, totalPages, date, title or url are filled in. Use inline styles with a font-size (Chromium defaults to a tiny font) and leave room with marginTop

params.name: footerTemplate
params.description: HTML printed at the bottom of every page, with the same placeholders as headerTemplate, e.g. of

htmltotext.title: HTML to Text
htmltotext.description: HTML to Text extracts clean plain text from raw HTML markup, reporting word counts and character counts. It identifies main article bodies automatically, records the extraction method used, and notes whether parsing succeeded.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML to convert to text

params.name: mode
params.description: auto (default): the main article, or all text when no article is found; article: the main article only; full: all visible text minus navigation, sidebars and banners, for emails, homepages and other non-article HTML

httpstatuslookup.title: HTTP Status Code Lookup
httpstatuslookup.description: HTTP Status Code Lookup decodes any HTTP status code by returning its standard name and detailed description. Provide a numeric code to inspect its meaning and response behavior across standard ranges, and add details=true for a link to the defining RFC section, plus on paid plans its retry and caching behavior and the headers that go with it.

params.name: code
params.description: HTTP status code to lookup

params.name: details
params.description: Also return the registry name, defining RFC section and link, retry and default-caching flags, and related headers

humannameparser.title: Human Name Parser
humannameparser.description: Human Name Parser splits full name strings into first, middle, and last names, titles, nicknames, and suffixes. It also generates initials directly from the detected components.

params.name: name
params.description: The human name to parse
params.example: MR. MARTINO PETROS DE FLORENCE (TINO) Jr.

ibanvalidator.title: IBAN Validator
ibanvalidator.description: IBAN Validator checks an IBAN's mod-97 checksum, its length and format for the country, and national check digits where the country defines them. It returns whether the IBAN is valid, the country and the reasons it fails. Paid plans add the bank code, branch code and account number, the correct check digits, and the SEPA, EU and EEA flags.

params.name: iban
params.description: The IBAN to validate. Spaces, dashes and lower case are accepted

ifsclookup.title: IFSC Lookup
ifsclookup.description: IFSC Lookup is an IFSC code search API that verifies Indian bank branch details from any IFSC code, returning the bank name, branch, street address, city, district and state, plus the state's ISO code and the bank and branch codes.
