Paid plans add MICR, SWIFT and the NEFT, RTGS, IMPS and UPI flags.

params.name: ifsc
params.description: The IFSC code to get information about

imagecaption.title: Image Caption
imagecaption.description: Image Caption generates natural language descriptions for uploaded image files. Upload a JPG, PNG, or GIF up to 5MB to receive an automated caption for alt text and media tagging.

imageconverter.title: Image Converter
imageconverter.description: Image Converter transforms images between formats. Convert HEIC from iPhones, modern WebP and AVIF formats, or classic PNG, JPG, GIF, and TIFF. Includes optional resizing and quality control, and paid plans also get the pixel width and height of the converted file.

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: Target format

params.name: quality
params.description: Output quality (applies to jpg/webp)

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum width in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Maximum height in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

imagetopdf.title: Image to PDF
imagetopdf.description: Image to PDF combines up to 20 images, uploaded or fetched from URLs, into one PDF with one image per page, and returns a download link valid for 2 days. Pages can match each image or be A4, Letter or Legal with a margin, and multi-page TIFF scans and animated GIFs become one page per frame.

params.name: urls
params.description: A JSON array of public image URLs, added in order after image; a comma- or newline-separated list also works. Up to 20 images per call in all

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Page size: fit makes each page the size of its image; a4, letter and legal fit the image inside the margins

params.name: orientation
params.description: Page orientation for a4, letter and legal; auto turns each page to match its image. Ignored for fit

params.name: margin
params.description: Margin around each image in millimetres, from 0 to 50

params.name: quality
params.description: Re-compress every image as JPG at this quality (1-100) to make the PDF smaller. Omit to keep JPG and PNG images unchanged

imagetotext.title: Image to Text
imagetotext.description: Image to Text is an OCR and image to text API that extracts text from image files or remote image URLs using optical character recognition. Upload a JPG, PNG, or GIF up to 5 MB to receive the raw extracted text.

params.name: language
params.description: Language of the text, as ISO 639-1 codes; comma-separate several for mixed text (e.g. en,ja). Defaults to en

imeigenerator.title: IMEI Generator
imeigenerator.description: IMEI Generator creates valid International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) numbers with proper Luhn checksum validation for mobile devices.

params.name: brand
params.description: Filter by manufacturer brand (e.g., Samsung, Apple, Nokia)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of IMEIs to generate

incomestatement.title: Income Statement
incomestatement.description: Income Statement returns the profit and loss statement for a US public company by ticker - revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating income and net income - straight from SEC filings, with gross, operating and net margins and year-over-year growth calculated for you.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year to retrieve. Defaults to latest available. History covers only the quarters captured so far; a missing period answers 404 listing the available ones.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter to retrieve. Defaults to latest available.

incometax.title: Income Tax Brackets
incometax.description: Income Tax Brackets retrieves US federal income tax brackets, marginal rates, and standard deductions across all filing statuses, and with state=CA (any state or DC) adds that state's brackets, standard deduction and personal exemption. Paid plans can query specific historical tax years back to 2000.

params.name: country
params.description: The country code (currently only 'US' is supported)

params.name: year
params.description: The tax year to retrieve brackets for. Defaults to the previous year.

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter US state code (or DC) to add that state's income tax brackets, standard deduction and personal exemption. States with no wage income tax return hasIncomeTax false. State tables start at 2023; a later year not yet published uses the latest edition.

incometaxcalculator.title: Income Tax Calculator
incometaxcalculator.description: Income Tax Calculator computes US federal income tax and take-home pay from gross income and filing status. It outputs total tax owed, effective and marginal rates, standard deductions, and net monthly income, can add Social Security and Medicare (FICA) for true take-home pay, and with state=NY adds that state's income tax on the same income.

params.name: income
params.description: Gross annual income in USD

params.name: rate
params.description: Tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 22 for 22%)

params.name: deduction
params.description: Optional deduction amount to subtract from income before calculating tax

indiapincode.title: India Pincode Lookup
indiapincode.description: India Pincode Lookup is an Indian PIN code API covering all ~19,300 PIN codes and ~157,000 post offices. Look up a PIN code to get its district, state, ISO state code, India Post circle, region, division and post office count, or search by post office, district or state, while paid plans add coordinates, every post office with its type and delivery status, and nearby PIN codes by distance.

params.name: pincode
params.description: Six-digit PIN code

params.name: office
params.description: Post office name or part of it

params.name: district
params.description: District name. Former and everyday city names work (Bangalore, Gurgaon, Bombay, Noida, Delhi), and a name that is the start of several districts returns all of them (Bengaluru covers Bengaluru Urban and Rural)

params.name: state
params.description: State or union territory name

params.name: nearby
params.description: With pincode, include the PIN codes within radius km

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius in km for nearby (1-50)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum PIN codes to return for searches (1-50)

inflation.title: Inflation Rate
inflation.description: Inflation Rate reports annual inflation rates and Consumer Price Index (CPI) values for any country by two-letter country code. Outputs include the year-over-year price change percentage, CPI index, and base comparison year, with paid plans supporting historical lookups by year. On paid plans, changes=true adds the prior year's rate and the change from it, plus the 5-year average, high, low and cumulative CPI rise.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2-letter or 3-letter country code (e.g., US, USA, GB, JP, DE, BR). UK is accepted for GB

params.name: year
params.description: The year to retrieve data for. Defaults to the most recent year with published data for that country (usually one to two years behind).

params.name: changes
params.description: Include the previous year's rate, the change from it, and the 5-year average, high, low and CPI rise

initialismgenerator.title: Initialism Generator
initialismgenerator.description: Initialism Generator creates initialisms from phrases by extracting first letters of significant words, with options for filtering and formatting.

params.name: phrase
params.description: Phrase to convert to initialism (max 500 characters)

params.name: excludeCommonWords
params.description: Exclude common words like 'the', 'of', 'and'

params.name: uppercase
params.description: Return the initialism in uppercase

insidertrading.title: Insider Trading
insidertrading.description: Insider Trading returns recent SEC Form 4 insider transactions for a US public company by ticker - who bought or sold, their role, the number of shares, price and transaction type - plus a derived insider-sentiment summary with net buy/sell activity and cluster-buy detection calculated for you.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: type
params.description: Filter to open-market buys or sells (buy or sell).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of transactions to return (1-25). Defaults to 5.

institutionalholdings.title: Institutional Holdings
institutionalholdings.description: Institutional Holdings returns SEC Form 13F holdings: every position a fund manager reported for a quarter, with shares, value, portfolio weight, put/call, discretion and voting authority, plus the quarter-over-quarter change on every position. Look up a manager by CIK or name, or reverse it and list every institution holding a ticker or CUSIP.

params.name: cik
params.description: SEC Central Index Key of the 13F filer, e.g. 1067983 for Berkshire Hathaway. Returns that manager's holdings.

params.name: manager
params.description: Manager name to search for instead of cik, e.g. bridgewater. The best match is returned, with other close matches in otherMatches.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Ticker symbol. Alone, lists the managers holding it; with cik or manager, filters that manager's holdings to it.

params.name: cusip
params.description: 9-character CUSIP. Alone, lists the managers holding it; with cik or manager, filters that manager's holdings to it.

params.name: period
params.description: Quarter to read, as a quarter end (2026-03-31) or quarter (2026Q1). Defaults to the latest quarter.

params.name: changeType
params.description: Only positions that are new, increased, decreased, unchanged or soldout since the previous quarter. Sold-out positions appear only with soldout.

params.name: putCall
params.description: Option filter: put, call, none (shares and principal only) or all. Defaults to all.

params.name: minValue
params.description: Only positions worth at least this many US dollars.

params.name: maxValue
params.description: Only positions worth at most this many US dollars.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by value (default), shares, change (share change), changepercent or portfolio (weight).

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order: desc (default) or asc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Rows to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

params.name: offset
params.description: Rows to skip, for paging through a large portfolio or holder list.

params.name: summary
params.description: Add a summary: for a manager, value change, position counts by change type, top-10 concentration and turnover; for a security, holder flows and top-10 share concentration.

interestrate.title: Interest Rate
interestrate.description: Interest Rate retrieves central bank policy rates for 23 major economies by country code. It delivers the latest interest rate percentage, central bank name, recorded date, and whether the rate moved up, down, or remained unchanged, while paid plans add the 12-month change, the 12-month high, low and average, and the last 12 monthly rates.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code: AU, BR, CA, CH, CN, CZ, DK, EU (euro area), GB, HU, IL, IN, JP, KR, MX, NO, NZ, PL, RU, SE, TR, US or ZA. ISO 3-letter codes (USA, GBR) and UK are also accepted

params.name: date
params.description: Optional month in YYYY-MM format for a historical lookup. Omit for the current rate.

params.name: history
params.description: Include the 12 monthly rates ending at the returned month

params.name: changes
params.description: Include the 12-month change and the 12-month high, low and average

invoicegenerator.title: Invoice Generator
invoicegenerator.description: Invoice Generator is an invoice generation API that creates downloadable PDF invoices from party addresses, line items, and payment terms. It computes subtotals with discounts and sales tax, returning an expiring download link.

params.name: invoiceNumber
params.description: The invoice number

params.name: date
params.description: The invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

params.name: from_name
params.description: The name of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.name: from_street
params.description: The street address of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.name: from_city
params.description: The city of the person or company issuing the invoice

params.name: from_state
params.description: The state, province or region of the person or company issuing the invoice (optional; left out of the address when blank)

params.name: from_zip
params.description: The postal or ZIP code of the person or company issuing the invoice (optional; any country's format)

params.name: from_country
params.description: The country of the person or company issuing the invoice, printed as its own address line (optional)

params.name: from_taxId
params.description: VAT, GST, ABN or other tax registration number of the person or company issuing the invoice, printed as a Tax ID line (optional)

params.name: to_name
params.description: The name of the person or company being invoiced

params.name: to_street
params.description: The street address of the person or company being invoiced

params.name: to_city
params.description: The city of the person or company being invoiced

params.name: to_state
params.description: The state, province or region of the person or company being invoiced (optional; left out of the address when blank)

params.name: to_zip
params.description: The postal or ZIP code of the person or company being invoiced (optional; any country's format)

params.name: to_country
params.description: The country of the person or company being invoiced, printed as its own address line (optional)

params.name: to_taxId
params.description: VAT, GST, ABN or other tax registration number of the person or company being invoiced, printed as a Tax ID line (optional)

params.name: job
params.description: The job or project associated with the invoice

params.name: paymentTerms
params.description: The payment terms for the invoice

params.name: dueDate
params.description: The due date for the invoice (YYYY-MM-DD format)

params.name: discount
params.description: The discount to be applied to the invoice

params.name: salesTax
params.description: The sales tax rate for the invoice as a percentage, applied to the subtotal after discount (e.g. 7.5 for 7.5%)

params.name: taxLabel
params.description: Label for the tax row, for example VAT or GST (default: Sales Tax)

params.name: logoURL
params.description: Public http(s) URL of an image to use as the invoice logo (max 2 MB, fetched with a 5 second timeout). The invoice has no logo when this is omitted or the image can't be loaded

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency code for the invoice; amounts are labelled with it and use its decimal places

params.name: items
params.description: The items being invoiced, one object per line: qty, description, unit_price

ipblacklistlookup.title: IP Blacklist Lookup
ipblacklistlookup.description: IP Blacklist Lookup is an IP blacklist check API that tells you whether a given IP address appears on known malicious IP blocklists. Identifies both inbound threats (attackers, spammers) and outbound threats (C2 servers, malware hosts).

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to check against blocklists

ipdemographics.title: IP Demographics
ipdemographics.description: IP Demographics combines IP geolocation with Census demographic data to provide demographic information for any IP address. Get location, income, education, and housing data based on the IP's geographic location. Demographics cover US ZIP codes; other locations return the location with demographics set to null.

params.name: ip
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address

iplookup.title: IP Lookup
iplookup.description: IP Lookup is an IP address location API that resolves any IP to its country, region, timezone and continent, with the country's currency, calling code, languages and flag and the local time there. Private and reserved addresses are labelled instead of failing. Paid plans add city, coordinates, postal code, an accuracy radius, an EU-membership flag, ASN and the reverse DNS hostname.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address for which you want to get the location data (e.g., 173.172.81.20)

isbnvalidator.title: ISBN Validator
isbnvalidator.description: ISBN Validator checks ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 numbers for valid checksums, parses their registration group, publisher, and title parts, and converts a valid number to its ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 forms. Pass any raw book identifier with or without hyphens to inspect normalized digits, format type, and specific rejection reasons.

params.name: isbn
params.description: The ISBN number to validate (ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, with or without separators)

jobpostings.title: Job Postings
jobpostings.description: Job Postings is a jobs API that returns the open positions on a company's public career board. Every job comes back in the same shape: title, department, team, locations, remote and workplace type, employment type, posting date and apply link. Filter by keyword, location, department, employment type, posting date or remote. Paid plans add the full job description and salary ranges where the company publishes them.

params.name: company
params.description: The company's career board name, usually the company name in lowercase, for example airbnb, stripe or palantir. Required unless url is given.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Return only jobs whose title, department or team contains every word given, for example engineer or product designer.

params.name: location
params.description: Return only jobs with a location containing this text, for example London, New York or Germany.

params.name: remote
params.description: true returns only jobs open to remote work; false only jobs that are not.

params.name: department
params.description: Return only jobs whose department or team contains this text, for example Engineering or Sales.

params.name: employmentType
params.description: Return only jobs of this employment type. Jobs whose board gives no employment type are kept, since many boards leave it blank; only jobs of another type are left out.

params.name: postedSince
params.description: Return only jobs first published at or after this date or date-time (ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01), or within this age: a number followed by h, d or w, for example 12h, 7d or 2w. Jobs with no posting date are left out when this is set.

params.name: minSalary
params.description: Return only jobs whose salary range reaches at least this amount, in the job's own currency and pay period: the top of the range is compared, or the bottom when no top is given. Jobs that publish no salary are left out when this is set.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to return: 10 jobs per page on the free plan, 50 on paid plans.

jobsearch.title: Job Search
jobsearch.description: Job Search is a jobs API that searches the open positions at thousands of companies at once. Search by job title keywords, location, country, remote work, employment type, posting date or company, and get the newest matching jobs first, each with its title, company, location, country, workplace type, posting date and apply link. Paid plans add salary ranges, a minimum salary filter, larger pages and each job's full description.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Words that must all appear in the job title, for example data engineer or product designer.

params.name: location
params.description: Return only jobs with a location containing this text, for example London, New York or Bavaria.

params.name: country
params.description: Return only jobs in this country: an ISO 3166 code or a name, for example US, GB or Germany.

params.name: remote
params.description: true returns only jobs open to remote work; false only jobs that are not.

params.name: employmentType
params.description: Return only jobs of this employment type. Jobs that give no employment type are kept, since many companies leave it blank; only jobs of another type are left out.

params.name: postedSince
params.description: Return only jobs first published at or after this date or date-time (ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01), or within this age: a number followed by h, d or w, for example 12h, 7d or 2w.

params.name: company
params.description: Return only jobs at this company, by its career board name, usually the company name in lowercase, for example airbnb.

params.name: minSalary
params.description: Return only jobs whose salary range reaches at least this amount, in the job's own currency and pay period. Jobs that publish no salary are left out when this is set.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results: 10 jobs per page up to page 5 on the free plan, 50 per page up to page 10 on paid plans. To page through a search, prefer cursor, which carries on from where the last page stopped.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The nextCursor value from the previous response, to get the next page of the same search. Send it with the same filters; page is then ignored.

jobsreport.title: Jobs Report
jobsreport.description: Jobs Report provides monthly US employment data including unemployment rate, total employment, labor force participation, and employment by industry sector. The same data released in the monthly BLS jobs report.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM format for historical lookup. Omit for current data.

jsonschemagenerator.title: JSON Schema Generator
jsonschemagenerator.description: JSON Schema Generator is a JSON to JSON Schema API: it inspects sample JSON payloads and generates Draft-07 JSON Schema definitions with inferred types and property formats. It identifies formats like emails and dates, applies custom titles, and lists all properties as required.

params.name: json
params.description: The sample JSON data to generate a schema from

params.name: title
params.description: The title for the generated schema (default: 'Generated Schema')

params.name: description
params.description: Optional description for the schema

jsonschemavalidator.title: JSON Schema Validator
jsonschemavalidator.description: JSON Schema Validator is a JSON validator API that tests any JSON object against a JSON Schema you provide, so you can check JSON against its schema before trusting it. It reports pass-fail status and total error count, while paid plans add specific error messages.

params.name: schema
params.description: The JSON Schema to validate against

params.name: json
params.description: The JSON data to validate. An empty object is a valid document and is accepted.

jsontocsv.title: JSON to CSV Converter
jsontocsv.description: JSON to CSV Converter converts an array of JSON objects into structured CSV text. It outputs formatted CSV content, detected column headers, and row counts, with support for custom delimiters like commas, tabs, or pipes.

params.name: json
params.description: The JSON array to convert to CSV (must be array of objects)

params.name: delimiter
params.description: The delimiter to use in the CSV

params.name: include_header
params.description: Whether to include column headers in the output (default: true)

params.name: flatten
params.description: Flatten nested objects into dot-path columns such as customer.address.city instead of writing them as JSON in one cell (default: false)

jsontojsonp.title: JSON to JSONP
jsontojsonp.description: JSON to JSONP wraps JSON data in a JavaScript callback function to produce valid JSONP output. Pass an object or JSON string with an optional callback identifier to receive the formatted script string.

params.name: json
params.description: The JSON data you want converted into JSONP format. Send it as an object or as a JSON-encoded string.

params.name: callback
params.description: The callback function name to wrap the JSON data. Must be a JavaScript identifier, optionally dotted (e.g. myCallback or window.myCallback).

julianday.title: Julian Day Calculator
julianday.description: Julian Day Calculator converts between Gregorian calendar dates and Julian Day Numbers (JDN). Julian Day is a continuous count of days used in astronomy and historical research.

params.name: date
params.description: The Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD format. An ISO date-time (2024-03-15T18:00:00Z) is also accepted and sets the time used for julianDate; without Z or an offset the time is read as UT

jwtdecoder.title: JWT Decoder
jwtdecoder.description: JWT Decoder decodes JWT tokens to reveal header and payload information, and on paid plans verifies the signature against a public key you supply. It handles JSON web token decode from any language over REST, so you can inspect claims and expiry without adding a JWT library.

params.name: token
params.description: JWT token to decode; a pasted Authorization header value (Bearer <token>) is accepted

params.name: publicKey
params.description: Public key to verify the signature with: a PEM public key, a PEM X.509 certificate, or a JWK (as a JSON object or string). Asymmetric algorithms only; HMAC secrets are refused and keys are never fetched from URLs. Omit it to decode only.

keywordextractor.title: Keyword Extractor
keywordextractor.description: Keyword Extractor is a keyword extraction API that scans raw text or live webpage URLs to extract key terms and their frequencies. It returns up to 50 unique keywords, occurrence counts, total keyword volume, and the top five terms with their percentage share.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to extract keywords from

languagedetector.title: Language Detector
languagedetector.description: Language Detector is a language detection API that identifies the language of text in Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Greek, Hebrew, Thai, Chinese, Japanese and Korean scripts, including one-line messages. It returns the primary language, its ISO 639-1 code, and candidate matches ranked by confidence scores.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to detect the language of

leetspeak.title: Leet Speak
leetspeak.description: Leet Speak translates plain text into leet speak or reverses obfuscated strings back to standard words. Submit any string with an encode or decode mode to receive the converted text and a count of changed characters.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode or decode in Leet Speak

params.name: mode
params.description: The mode to use

lemmatizer.title: Text Lemmatizer
lemmatizer.description: Text Lemmatizer reduces inflected words in submitted text down to their dictionary base forms. It confirms when valid lemmas exist, while paid plans return each lemma with its occurrence count.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to lemmatize

levenshteindistance.title: Levenshtein Distance
levenshteindistance.description: Levenshtein Distance calculates the minimum number of single-character edits needed to transform one string into another.

params.name: string1
params.description: First string to compare (max 10,000 characters)

params.name: string2
params.description: Second string to compare (max 10,000 characters)

lexicon.title: Word Lexicon Analyzer
lexicon.description: Word Lexicon Analyzer inspects any single word to check linguistic properties including palindromes, isograms, and Scrabble validity. It identifies anagram potential, alphagram status, and sorted letter forms.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to analyze

linesorter.title: Line Sorter
linesorter.description: Line Sorter organizes text by sorting lines alphabetically in ascending or descending order with case-sensitive options.

params.name: lines
params.description: Array of text lines to sort (max 10,000)

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order

params.name: caseSensitive
params.description: Enable case-sensitive sorting

params.name: natural
params.description: Natural (numeric-aware) order: runs of digits compare as numbers, so item2 sorts before item10

params.name: unique
params.description: Remove duplicate lines before sorting (case-insensitive unless caseSensitive is true); the first spelling is kept

linkscraper.title: Link Scraper
linkscraper.description: Link Scraper is a website link extractor API that pulls internal and external links from any webpage URL in real time. It resolves relative paths to absolute URLs, strips empty fragments, and returns anchor text with internal and external counts.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to scrape links from (a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com; https:// is assumed when no scheme is given)

params.name: maxlinks
params.description: Maximum number of links to scrape and return

params.name: includequery
params.description: Include query strings in the scraped links

params.name: unique
params.description: Return each href once, skipping repeats before the maxlinks cap (by default every anchor is returned, repeats included)

liturgicalcalendar.title: Liturgical Calendar
liturgicalcalendar.description: Liturgical Calendar retrieves Catholic liturgical calendar events for any given month. It details feast ranks, vestment colors, liturgical seasons, and holy days of obligation, while paid plans add custom year queries.

params.name: month
params.description: The month to get Liturgical Calendar data for (default: current month)

params.name: year
params.description: The year to get Liturgical Calendar data for (default: current year)

loanpaymentcalculator.title: Loan Calculator
loanpaymentcalculator.description: Loan Calculator is a payment calculation API that computes monthly loan payments, total interest, and overall loan costs based on principal, annual interest rate, and term length in years or months. Include an optional down payment to determine adjusted financing balances and interest ratios. On paid plans, optional inputs add an extra-payment payoff plan with months and interest saved, payoff dates from a start date, biweekly or weekly payment figures, and an APR that includes upfront fees.

params.name: loanAmount
params.description: The loan amount (0 to 1,000,000,000,000)

params.name: interestRate
params.description: The interest rate (percentage)

params.name: loanTerm
params.description: The loan term in whole years (e.g. 5 or 30). For terms quoted in months, send loanTermMonths instead

params.name: loanTermMonths
params.description: The loan term in months (e.g. 36, 60, 72, 75). Overrides loanTerm; use it for auto and personal loans quoted in months, including terms that are not whole years such as 18 or 30

params.name: downpayment
params.description: Amount paid up front, subtracted from the loan amount before interest is applied

params.name: extraPayment
params.description: Extra principal paid every month. Adds an extra_payment block with the early payoff month, months saved and interest saved

params.name: startDate
params.description: Loan start date (YYYY-MM-DD), with the first payment one month later. Adds the payoff date

params.name: paymentFrequency
params.description: Also price the loan on a biweekly (26 a year) or weekly (52 a year) schedule. Adds a payment_frequency block; monthly figures are unchanged

params.name: fees
params.description: Upfront fees deducted from the amount the borrower receives (origination, closing). Adds the APR including those fees

loremipsumgenerator.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator
loremipsumgenerator.description: Lorem Ipsum Generator generates placeholder text by paragraph count with optional length limits and standard opening phrasing. Every response includes the dummy copy plus word and sentence counts.

params.name: paragraphs
params.description: The number of paragraphs to generate

params.name: startwithlorem
params.description: Start the text with 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet'

params.name: maxlength
params.description: The maximum length of the generated text (0 for no limit)

lottery.title: Lottery Numbers
lottery.description: Lottery Numbers fetches winning lottery numbers, bonus balls, draw dates, and jackpot amounts for major games. Specify Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, or Lotto Max to receive draw results with prize totals, and on paid plans the next draw's estimate and number frequency statistics from the last 100 draws.

params.name: numbers
params.description: The lottery game to lookup: powerball, megamillions, euromillions, or lottomax (mega millions and mega_millions are also accepted)

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date for historical lookup (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the nearest draw within 30 days of this date; history depth varies by game, and a date outside it returns 404 with the covered range.

params.name: stats
params.description: Include number frequency statistics over the last 100 draws

lotterypicker.title: Lottery Number Generator
lotterypicker.description: Lottery Number Generator creates random lottery numbers for various popular games including Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, and custom lottery configurations.

params.name: game
params.description: Lottery game preset; pick3 and pick4 are US daily digit games (each digit 0-9, repeats allowed, order kept) and uklotto is the UK Lotto 6 from 59

params.name: numbers
params.description: Number of main numbers to pick (for custom game)

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number for main numbers (for custom game)

params.name: bonus
params.description: Number of bonus numbers (for custom game)

params.name: tickets
params.description: Number of tickets to generate

params.name: bonusmax
params.description: Highest value a bonus ball can take. Only applies when game is custom; named games use their own rules

lovecalculator.title: Love Calculator
lovecalculator.description: Love Calculator calculates romantic compatibility between any two names, returning a match percentage and summary text. Paid plans add detailed compatibility advice for the pair.

params.name: name1
params.description: The first name to calculate love compatibility

params.name: name2
params.description: The second name to calculate love compatibility

macaddresslookup.title: MAC Address Lookup
macaddresslookup.description: MAC Address Lookup validates any MAC address and converts it across standard colon, dash, dot, and raw hex formats. Add addressing=true to read whether it is unicast, multicast or broadcast, and on paid plans whether it is universal or locally administered (the mark of a randomized private address). On paid plans it also becomes a MAC vendor lookup API, adding the device hardware vendor and OUI identifier.

params.name: mac
params.description: The MAC address for which you want to get the data (e.g., 00-B0-D0-63-C2-26)

params.name: addressing
params.description: Include the address type decoded from the first octet: unicast, multicast or broadcast, and universal or locally administered

madlibs.title: Mad Libs Generator
madlibs.description: Mad Libs Generator is a Mad Libs API that creates fill-in-the-blank story templates with prompts for nouns, verbs, adjectives, and more.

params.name: category
params.description: Story category

params.name: count
params.description: Number of stories

magic8ball.title: Magic 8-Ball
magic8ball.description: Magic 8-Ball is a fun tool that provides random predictions and answers like the classic toy. It returns one of 20 classic Magic 8-Ball responses categorized as affirmative, negative, or non-committal.

params.name: question
params.description: Your question for the Magic 8-Ball (optional)

marineweather.title: Marine Weather
marineweather.description: Marine Weather fetches offshore weather conditions for any marine coordinates by latitude and longitude. Each response details significant wave height, swell, water temperature and gusts alongside high and low temperatures, maximum wind speeds, precipitation totals, humidity, UV index, and sunrise and sunset times.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude coordinate of the location

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude coordinate of the location

markdownlinkextractor.title: Markdown Link Extractor
markdownlinkextractor.description: Markdown Link Extractor parses markdown documents and extracts all links including inline, reference, autolinks, and image URLs.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Markdown text to parse (max 100,000 characters)

markdowntable.title: Markdown Table Generator
markdowntable.description: Markdown Table Generator converts structured data into properly formatted markdown tables with customizable column alignment.

params.name: headers
params.description: Array of column header names. Required when rows are arrays; with object rows it picks and orders the columns, and when omitted the headers come from the objects' keys

params.name: rows
params.description: Array of row arrays, or an array of objects such as an API or database result (headers derived from the keys when omitted)

params.name: alignment
params.description: Column alignment: left, center, right, or array of alignments per column

markdowntohtml.title: Markdown to HTML
markdowntohtml.description: Markdown to HTML is a markdown converter API that parses markdown syntax and converts it to clean, semantic HTML suitable for web rendering and content management.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Markdown text to convert (max 500,000 characters); leading indentation and trailing spaces are kept

markdowntoimage.title: Markdown to Image
markdowntoimage.description: Markdown to Image converts markdown text into visual image representations, rendering content as PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Markdown text to convert

params.name: width
params.description: Image width in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Image height in pixels

params.name: format
params.description: Output image format

markdowntopdf.title: Markdown to PDF
markdowntopdf.description: Markdown to PDF is a PDF generator API that converts markdown text into professionally formatted PDF documents, with a clean default stylesheet (sans-serif text, bordered tables, shaded code blocks), and returns a temporary download URL for each file. Paid plans can set the paper size, orientation and margins, style the document with their own CSS, and print a header and footer with page numbers on every page.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Markdown text to convert (max 500,000 characters)

params.name: format
params.description: Paper size

params.name: landscape
params.description: Set to true for landscape orientation

params.name: marginTop
params.description: The top margin in inches

params.name: marginRight
params.description: The right margin in inches

params.name: marginBottom
params.description: The bottom margin in inches

params.name: marginLeft
params.description: The left margin in inches

params.name: css
params.description: Stylesheet applied after the default one, so its rules win, e.g. body { font-family: Georgia, serif } table { border-collapse: collapse }

params.name: headerTemplate
params.description: HTML printed at the top of every page. Spans with class pageNumber, totalPages, date or title are filled in. Use inline styles with a font-size (Chromium defaults to a tiny font) and leave room with marginTop

params.name: footerTemplate
params.description: HTML printed at the bottom of every page, with the same placeholders as headerTemplate, e.g. of

math.title: Math Calculator
math.description: Math Calculator performs mathematical operations including arithmetic, number properties, base conversions, and expression evaluation. Decimal results are rounded to 15 significant digits, as a calculator shows them, so 0.1 + 0.2 returns 0.3.

params.name: operation
params.description: Operation to perform

params.name: a
params.description: First number

params.name: b
params.description: Second number

mayancalendar.title: Mayan Calendar
mayancalendar.description: Mayan Calendar converts Gregorian dates to the ancient Mayan calendar system. Returns the Long Count, Tzolkin (260-day sacred calendar), and Haab (365-day civil calendar) dates.

params.name: date
params.description: The Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD format

maze.title: Maze Generator
maze.description: Maze Generator creates random mazes using recursive backtracking algorithm with customizable size and difficulty.

params.name: width
params.description: Maze width

params.name: height
params.description: Maze height

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level; harder mazes have a longer solution path

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable maze image

params.name: solutionImage
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable solution image

meetingtimeconverter.title: Meeting Time Converter
meetingtimeconverter.description: Meeting Time Converter transforms meeting times between any two timezones, calculating time differences and UTC offsets for global coordination.

params.name: time
params.description: Time in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format (24-hour)

params.name: fromTimezone
params.description: Source timezone: an IANA name (America/New_York), a North American abbreviation (EST, EDT, PST, PDT and so on, always DST-aware) or a UTC/GMT offset such as UTC+05:30

params.name: toTimezone
params.description: Target timezone, in the same forms as fromTimezone

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

menstrualcycle.title: Menstrual Cycle Calculator
menstrualcycle.description: Menstrual Cycle Calculator is a period tracker API that predicts future menstrual cycles, fertile windows, and ovulation dates from the last period date and the average cycle and period length.

params.name: last_period
params.description: First day of last menstrual period (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: cycle_length
params.description: Average cycle length in days (18-60; decimals such as 29.5 are rounded to the nearest whole day)

params.name: period_length
params.description: Average period duration in days

params.name: cycles
params.description: Number of future cycles to calculate

metadataextractor.title: Metadata Extractor
metadataextractor.description: Metadata Extractor is a website metadata extraction API that pulls HTML meta tags from any submitted URL, returning the page title, meta description, author, robots directives, and language. Paid tiers add Open Graph tags, JSON-LD schemas, and favicons.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to extract metadata from; without a scheme, https:// is assumed

meteorites.title: Meteorite Landings
meteorites.description: Meteorite Landings searches recorded meteor strikes by specimen name and minimum mass. Each record includes the official specimen name, meteorite classification, mass in grams, and the recorded fall year.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the meteorite you want to search for

params.name: mass
params.description: Minimum mass of the meteorite in grams

params.name: year
params.description: The year the meteorite fell to Earth

mimetypelookup.title: MIME Type Lookup
mimetypelookup.description: MIME Type Lookup matches file extensions to MIME types, categories, and default character encodings, or returns matching extensions for any media type. Paid plans add gzip compressibility flags, the registry that defines each type (IANA, Apache or nginx), and every extension sharing that type.

params.name: extension
params.description: File extension to lookup (without the leading dot)

minimumwage.title: Minimum Wage
minimumwage.description: Minimum Wage provides current minimum wage rates for all US states plus the federal minimum. Includes tipped minimum wages, effective rates (higher of state or federal), and historical federal minimum wage data.

params.name: state
params.description: 2-letter state code (e.g., CA, NY)

params.name: year
params.description: Year to get minimum wage for (e.g., 2020). Defaults to current year.

moonphases.title: Moon Phases
moonphases.description: Moon Phases calculates the current lunar phase, illumination percentage, and lunar age for today. It reports waxing or waning status, Earth-moon distance in Earth radii and kilometers, the next principal phase and emoji representations, while paid plans add custom date queries and the dates of the next new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter.

params.name: today
params.description: Get the moon phase for today

params.name: phases
params.description: Include the dates of the next new moon, first quarter and last quarter and the days to each

moonposition.title: Moon Position
moonposition.description: Moon Position calculates the moon's altitude in the sky for any latitude and longitude coordinates. Provide an optional time of day to determine lunar elevation; paid plans add custom dates, azimuth, and distance.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the location

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the location

params.name: date
params.description: The date to get the moon position data for (MM-DD-YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD). An ISO date-time such as 2026-06-21T21:00:00 is also accepted and supplies the time; with Z or an offset it is read as that exact instant. Years 1700 to 2300 are supported

params.name: time
params.description: The time of day for the calculation (HH:mm, 24-hour; HH:mm:ss and 12-hour times such as 9:00 PM are also accepted, seconds are ignored). Defaults to 00:00 if not provided

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone name the date and time are given in. Defaults to the timezone of the supplied coordinates

moonrisemoonset.title: Moonrise Moonset
moonrisemoonset.description: Moonrise Moonset calculates exact moonrise and moonset times for any geographic coordinate. It outputs ISO 8601 timestamps for lunar rise and set events, with paid plans adding moon phase details and date selection.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the location

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the location

params.name: date
params.description: The date to get the moonrise and moonset times for (MM-dd-yyyy)

params.name: local
params.description: Also return the IANA timezone of the coordinates and moonrise/moonset as local ISO 8601 times

morsecode.title: Morse Code
morsecode.description: Morse Code is a Morse code translator and decoder API: it converts plain text to Morse code dots and dashes and translates Morse back into text. It provides character counts, dit and dah totals, and validation status, while paid plans add downloadable audio tones.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode or decode in Morse code

params.name: audio
params.description: Set to true to include an audio file of the Morse code. Audio is generated only when the encoded morse is 300 characters or fewer (roughly 60-80 characters of text); longer input returns audio: null with an audioError

mortgagecalculator.title: Mortgage Calculator
mortgagecalculator.description: Mortgage Calculator computes monthly and annual loan payments from principal, interest rate, and term. It breaks totals down by principal, interest, property tax, insurance, and HOA dues and returns the loan-to-value ratio, with paid plans adding full amortization schedules, PMI and its removal date, payoff dates, and extra-payment scenarios showing months and interest saved.

params.name: amount
params.description: The loan amount (0 to 1,000,000,000,000)

params.name: rate
params.description: The interest rate (percentage)

params.name: years
params.description: The loan term in years

params.name: downpayment
params.description: The down payment amount

params.name: annual_propertytax
params.description: The annual property tax amount

params.name: annual_homeinsurance
params.description: The annual home insurance amount

params.name: annual_hoa
params.description: The annual HOA amount

params.name: pmi_rate
params.description: Annual private mortgage insurance rate as a percentage of the loan, charged only when the loan-to-value ratio is above 80%

params.name: extra_monthly
params.description: Extra principal paid every month, to see how much sooner the loan is paid off and how much interest that saves

params.name: start_date
params.description: Loan start (closing) date; the first payment falls the following month

mortgagerate.title: Mortgage Rate
mortgagerate.description: Mortgage Rate reports weekly US fixed mortgage rates for 15-year and 30-year terms. Pass the loan term to get the latest percentage rate, survey date, and direction of weekly change, while paid plans add 4-week and 52-week changes, the 52-week high, low and average, and the last 52 weekly rates.

params.name: type
params.description: The mortgage type

params.name: year
params.description: Year to retrieve rates for (1971-present). Requires month parameter.

params.name: month
params.description: Month to retrieve rates for (1-12). Required when year is specified.

params.name: history
params.description: Include the weekly rates for the 52 weeks ending at the latest survey (current rate only)

params.name: changes
params.description: Include the 4-week and 52-week changes and the 52-week high, low and average (current rate only)

motorcarrierlookup.title: Motor Carrier Lookup
motorcarrierlookup.description: Motor Carrier Lookup returns the FMCSA record of a trucking or bus company from its USDOT number or its MC, MX or FF docket number. It covers USDOT status, entity and operation type, addresses, dockets, fleet and driver counts, MCS-150 date, safety rating, out-of-service orders, operating authority status and insurance on file. Paid plans add contact details, cargo classes, equipment, mileage, crash rate, insurance policies, authority history and pass/fail compliance checks with your own thresholds.

params.name: dot
params.description: USDOT number, for example 80806. Use dot, docket or mc

params.name: docket
params.description: Docket number with its prefix: MC, MX or FF, for example MC135797

params.name: mc
params.description: MC number without the prefix, for example 135797

params.name: checks
params.description: Add pass/fail compliance checks against the thresholds below

params.name: history
params.description: Add authority history and revocations

params.name: minBipd
params.description: Compliance threshold: minimum BI&PD insurance on file in US dollars

params.name: minCargo
params.description: Compliance threshold: minimum cargo insurance in US dollars; 0 skips the check

params.name: maxMcs150Months
params.description: Compliance threshold: the MCS-150 must be updated within this many months

params.name: minAuthorityDays
params.description: Compliance threshold: minimum days since operating authority was first granted

movielookup.title: Movie Lookup
movielookup.description: Movie Lookup returns the record of a film from its title, IMDb id or Wikidata id: release year and date, runtime, genres, countries, languages, director and cast. Paid plans add writers, producers, composer, cinematographer, editor, studios, distributors, awards, box office, budget, filming locations, franchise links and APIVerve's own 0-100 movie rating with acclaim and popularity scores. Covers about 450,000 films and filmed works: features, animation, documentaries, shorts, TV films and specials, music videos and more.

params.name: title
params.description: Film title to search, e.g. Inception. Use title, imdb or id

params.name: year
params.description: Release year, to pick one of several films with the same title

params.name: imdb
params.description: IMDb title id (tt1375666) or IMDb title URL

params.name: id
params.description: Wikidata id, e.g. Q25188

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum films to return for a title search (1-10)

params.name: cast
params.description: Return the full cast instead of the top 5

murmurhash.title: MurmurHash
murmurhash.description: MurmurHash generates fast, non-cryptographic hashes using the MurmurHash3 algorithm. Ideal for hash tables, data partitioning, bloom filters, and checksums where cryptographic security isn't needed.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to hash

params.name: seed
params.description: Seed value for the hash function, an unsigned 32-bit integer (0 to 4294967295)

params.name: variant
params.description: Hash variant: 32 (MurmurHash3_x86_32), 128 (MurmurHash3_x86_128) or 128x64 (MurmurHash3_x64_128, the 128-bit hash Python mmh3, Guava and Cassandra use)

musicnotegenerator.title: Music Note Generator
musicnotegenerator.description: Music Note Generator is a musical note generator API that creates high-quality WAV audio files of musical notes with precise frequency generation, plus customizable duration on paid plans.

params.name: note
params.description: Musical note (A-G with optional # or b)

params.name: octave
params.description: Octave number

params.name: duration
params.description: Duration in seconds

mxlookup.title: MX Lookup
mxlookup.description: MX Lookup queries DNS to find MX records for any domain. It returns an array of mail exchange hostnames and their priority routing values in real time.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain you want to get the MX records for (e.g. yahoo.com)

naicslookup.title: NAICS Lookup
naicslookup.description: NAICS Lookup is a NAICS code lookup and search API for the 2022 North American Industry Classification System. Look up one code or up to 500 at once, or search by keyword, and get the title, description, level, parent, hierarchy and children, while paid plans add the SBA small-business size standard, the Census index terms, cross-references and the 2017 concordance.

params.name: code
params.description: One NAICS code, or several separated by commas (up to 10 on Free, 500 on paid plans). NAICS 2017 codes retired in 2022 come back under retired with their replacements

params.name: search
params.description: Keywords to search titles, index terms and descriptions. Plain-language terms are understood too: online store or ecommerce, SaaS, IT consulting, and occupations such as plumber or electrician

params.name: level
params.description: Only return codes at this level when searching (2 to 6 digits)

params.name: details
params.description: Include index terms, cross-references and the NAICS 2017 concordance

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum search results (1-50)

nameservers.title: Nameservers
nameservers.description: Nameservers queries authoritative DNS records for any domain to list its nameservers, IP addresses, and reverse DNS records. It detects multiple DNS providers, counts total nameservers, and identifies who runs each server.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain name to lookup nameservers for

nationaldebt.title: National Debt
nationaldebt.description: National Debt provides the US national debt (Debt to the Penny), updated daily from the Treasury. It returns the total public debt, debt held by the public, intragovernmental holdings, per-capita debt calculations, the previous record's total, and on paid plans how much the debt grew over a day, 30 days and a year.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format for historical lookup. Omit for current data.

params.name: changes
params.description: Include the previous record's total and the growth over 1 day, 30 days and 1 year

neverhaveiever.title: Never Have I Ever
neverhaveiever.description: Never Have I Ever generates random statements for the popular party game. Features 330+ unique prompts with per-API-key tracking to avoid repeats.

params.name: adult
params.description: Include adult/relationship-focused statements

news.title: World News
news.description: World News is a global news API that reads about 275 outlet feeds in 29 editions and 6 languages and merges them into stories: one entry per story however many outlets carry it, ranked by that coverage. Filter by 13 topics, by the country a story is about, by the edition it ran in, or by language.

params.name: category
params.description: Only stories on this topic. A story is in every topic its headline and summary name, not only its feed's section.

params.name: country
params.description: Only stories about this country, from any outlet: an ISO 3166 code or English name, for example JP or Japan.

params.name: edition
params.description: Only stories run by outlets based in this country: what its press is covering, in the languages it writes in. See list=editions.

params.name: language
params.description: Only stories in this language. Defaults to English, or with edition to the languages that edition's press writes in. Stories are never translated.

params.name: sort
params.description: top ranks stories by how many outlets carry them, favouring the last 12 hours; latest is newest first.

params.name: q
params.description: Only stories whose headlines or summaries contain every word given, in any case. Without category or edition, q searches every section feed (business, tech, crypto, sport and the rest), not only front pages.

params.name: since
params.description: Only stories published at or after this date or date-time (ISO 8601), for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T14:00:00Z.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of stories to return: up to 10 on the free plan, 50 on paid plans.

nobelprizes.title: Nobel Prizes
nobelprizes.description: Nobel Prizes searches laureate records by first name, last name, and award category. Each result includes the winner's full name, award year, and category, while paid plans add year filtering, motivations, and biographical details.

params.name: firstname
params.description: The first name of the Nobel Prize winner to get information about

params.name: lastname
params.description: The last name of the Nobel Prize winner to get information about (accents optional: Schrodinger matches Schrödinger)

params.name: category
params.description: The category of the Nobel Prize to get information about (official names like Physiology or Medicine and Economic Sciences are accepted)

params.name: year
params.description: The year of the Nobel Prize to get information about

nsfwimagedetector.title: NSFW Image Detector
nsfwimagedetector.description: NSFW Image Detector is an NSFW detection API that checks whether an image contains explicit adult content. Upload a JPG, PNG or GIF up to 5 MB, or pass an image URL, to get isNSFW and isSafe flags.

numberbaseconverter.title: Number Base Converter
numberbaseconverter.description: Number Base Converter converts numbers between any base from 2 to 36, including binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal. Pass a value with optional source and target bases to receive the converted string, base names, and exact decimal values.

params.name: value
params.description: The number to convert. Prefixes matching the base (0x or # for hex, 0b for binary, 0o for octal) and space or underscore digit grouping are accepted

params.name: from
params.description: Source base (default: 10, or the base a 0x, #, 0b or 0o prefix names)

params.name: to
params.description: Target base (returns all common bases if not specified)

numbertowords.title: Number to Words
numbertowords.description: Number to Words is a number to words API that converts numeric values into written cardinal words and counts whole and fractional digits. Pass any integer or float to get the spelled-out text along with digit counts and locale information.

params.name: number
params.description: The number to convert to words

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency for the currencyWords block: USD (default), CAD, AUD, NZD, EUR, GBP, INR or ZAR. INR amounts are worded in lakh and crore

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Nutrition returns the nutrition facts for a generic whole food by name - calories and the core macronutrients per 100 grams straight from the USDA food composition database - plus, on paid plans, a full micronutrient panel and derived nutrition intelligence like calories per gram and the protein, fat and carbohydrate share of calories.

params.name: food
params.description: Name of the food to look up (e.g. banana, chicken breast, olive oil). A leading quantity such as 1 cup rice, 2 eggs or 100g chicken breast is accepted and reported in parsedQuantity

params.name: grams
params.description: Serving weight in grams to scale the nutrition panel to. Defaults to a per-100-gram basis.

objectdetector.title: Object Detector
objectdetector.description: Object Detector finds the objects in an image, from people, cars and traffic lights to dogs, laptops and cups, and returns each one's label, a numeric confidence and its bounding box in pixels and as fractions of the image, plus a count per label. Filter by minimum confidence or by the labels you care about.

params.name: minConfidence
params.description: Lowest confidence to return, from 0.05 to 1

params.name: labels
params.description: Comma-separated object labels to keep, such as person,car,dog; all 80 labels when omitted

officetopdf.title: Office to PDF
officetopdf.description: Office to PDF converts Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, text and CSV files to PDF and returns a download link valid for 2 days, with the page count of the result. Upload the file or send its URL. Wide spreadsheets can be fitted one sheet per page. Paid plans can convert only selected pages and set landscape orientation.

params.name: pageRanges
params.description: Pages to convert, such as 1-3,5. Converts the whole document when omitted

params.name: landscape
params.description: Lay the pages out in landscape orientation

params.name: singlePageSheets
params.description: Fit each spreadsheet sheet onto a single page, so wide sheets keep all their columns together. Spreadsheet inputs only

openlicenses.title: Open Source Licenses
openlicenses.description: Open Source Licenses is a software license API that looks up open source license details by name or identifier. It returns SPDX identifiers, canonical URLs, OSI approval status, legacy IDs, and domain applicability for software, content, or data.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the open source license to get information about. Accepts SPDX ids, full titles and common written forms (Apache 2.0, GPLv3, The MIT License), plus SPDX expressions like MIT OR Apache-2.0

ovulationcalculator.title: Ovulation Calculator
ovulationcalculator.description: Ovulation Calculator estimates ovulation dates, fertile windows, and provides detailed cycle phase information based on menstrual cycle data.

params.name: last_period
params.description: First day of last menstrual period (YYYY-MM-DD; DD.MM.YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY also work)

params.name: cycle_length
params.description: Average menstrual cycle length in days (18-60; decimals such as 29.5 are rounded to the nearest whole day)

palindromechecker.title: Palindrome Checker
palindromechecker.description: Palindrome Checker tests whether a string reads the same forwards and backwards, with options to ignore casing, spacing, and punctuation. It returns the boolean verdict, the normalized text, the reversed comparison string, and the length of the longest palindromic sequence.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to check for palindrome. Maximum 20000 characters
params.example: A man a plan a canal Panama

params.name: ignorecase
params.description: Ignore case when checking (default: true)

params.name: ignorespaces
params.description: Ignore spaces when checking (default: true)

params.name: ignorepunctuation
params.description: Ignore punctuation when checking (default: true)

palladiumprice.title: Palladium Price
palladiumprice.description: Palladium Price tracks real-time spot rates for palladium per ounce, gram, and kilogram in USD. It supplies 24-hour price changes and update timestamps, while paid plans add custom currencies, 7- and 30-day changes, 30-day stats, and hourly and 30-day daily history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

params.name: daily
params.description: Include the daily closing price per ounce for the last 30 days

partsofspeech.title: Parts Of Speech
partsofspeech.description: Parts Of Speech extracts words from text based on grammatical categories like nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Pass any text passage and a category to receive an array of matching words.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to extract words from

params.name: partofspeech
params.description: The part of speech to extract. Defaults to nouns

passwordbreach.title: Password Breach Checker
passwordbreach.description: Password Breach Checker tells you whether a password has been pwned: whether it appears in the Pwned Passwords corpus of passwords exposed in data breaches, the same corpus behind Have I Been Pwned. Send the password or its SHA-1 hash and get a breached flag. Paid plans add how many times it was seen and a risk level.

params.name: password
params.description: The password to check. Hashed on receipt and never stored. Send this or hash

params.name: hash
params.description: The 40-character hex SHA-1 of the password, instead of the password itself

passwordgenerator.title: Password Generator
passwordgenerator.description: Password Generator is a password generator API that creates random passwords, pronounceable passwords and multi-word passphrases from length, complexity and character-set rules, up to 100 per call. Each comes back with its length and the settings used to build it.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of passwords to generate

params.name: length
params.description: The length of the password to generate

params.name: complexity
params.description: The complexity of the password. Only applies when type is random

params.name: type
params.description: The kind of password to generate. random uses the complexity preset, pronounceable builds readable syllables, passphrase joins dictionary words, and custom honours the include/exclude switches below

params.name: includeNumbers
params.description: Include digits. Applies to custom and pronounceable, and to random at simple complexity

params.name: includeSymbols
params.description: Include punctuation symbols. Applies to custom, and to random at medium complexity

params.name: includeUppercase
params.description: Include uppercase letters. Applies to custom, and to random at simple complexity

params.name: includeLowercase
params.description: Include lowercase letters in a custom password. Set false to build from the other character sets only

params.name: excludeSimilar
params.description: Exclude characters that are easy to confuse when read aloud or typed (i, l, 1, L, o, 0, O)

params.name: excludeAmbiguous
params.description: Exclude brackets, slashes, quotes and other characters that need escaping in shells and config files

params.name: mixedCase
params.description: Randomly capitalise letters in a pronounceable password

params.name: strict
params.description: Guarantee at least one character from every enabled set rather than leaving it to chance

params.name: wordCount
params.description: How many words a passphrase contains. Only applies when type is passphrase

params.name: separator
params.description: The character placed between passphrase words. Only applies when type is passphrase

params.name: capitalize
params.description: Capitalise each word of a passphrase. Only applies when type is passphrase

params.name: analyze
params.description: Return a strength analysis alongside each password

passwordstrength.title: Password Strength
passwordstrength.description: Password Strength is a password strength checker API that scores how strong a password is. It returns a strength label and score, a breakdown of the character types used, weak-pattern detection, theoretical entropy in bits, and recommendations to improve it. Paid plans also check the password against over 2 billion breached passwords and return how often it has been seen.

params.name: password
params.description: The password to check the strength of

pdfmerge.title: PDF Merge
pdfmerge.description: PDF Merge combines 2 to 10 PDFs into one file, keeping their order, and returns a download link valid for 2 days. Upload the files or send their URLs. Paid plans add a breakdown of where each source document starts and ends in the merged file.

params.name: urls
params.description: A JSON array of 2 to 10 public PDF URLs, merged in order; a comma- or newline-separated list also works. Or upload the PDFs as multipart files instead

pdfpagenumbers.title: PDF Page Numbers
pdfpagenumbers.description: PDF Page Numbers stamps a page number on every page of a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, and returns a download link to the numbered file. Choose the corner or edge and the font size. Paid plans can also set a label format such as Page 3 of 12, the starting number, and skip a cover page.

params.name: position
params.description: Where to place the number

params.name: fontSize
params.description: Font size in points, from 6 to 36

params.name: format
params.description: Label template containing {page}, and optionally {total}, such as Page {page} of {total}

params.name: startAt
params.description: Number for the first numbered page

params.name: skipFirst
params.description: Leave the first page (a cover) unnumbered

pdftohtml.title: PDF to HTML
pdftohtml.description: PDF to HTML converts the pages of a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, into one self-contained HTML file that looks like the original: same layout, embedded fonts and images, and real selectable text. Choose a page range, unlock password-protected PDFs, or ask for text only; long documents are converted in batches, with nextPage pointing to the next one.

params.name: pages
params.description: One page or range: 3, 2-7, or 5- for page 5 onwards. Each call converts up to 10 pages (2 on the Free plan) from the start of the range; nextPage says where to continue

params.name: password
params.description: User or owner password of an encrypted PDF

params.name: textOnly
params.description: Leave out images and vector graphics and keep only the positioned text in its fonts

pdftoimage.title: PDF to Image
pdftoimage.description: PDF to Image renders the pages you choose from a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, as PNG or JPG images and returns a download link for each, valid for 2 days, with its pixel size. The Free plan renders one page per call at 150 dpi; paid plans render up to 10 pages per call and can set the resolution from 72 to 300 dpi.

params.name: pages
params.description: Pages to render, as numbers and ranges such as 1-3,5; at most 10 per call on paid plans, 1 on the Free plan

params.name: format
params.description: Image format

params.name: quality
params.description: JPG quality from 1 to 100; ignored for PNG

params.name: dpi
params.description: Resolution in dots per inch, from 72 to 300

pdftotext.title: PDF to Text
pdftotext.description: PDF to Text extracts the text layer of a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, and returns it as plain text with the page, word and character counts. Paid plans add the text of each page separately and the document metadata, such as title, author and creation date.

periodictable.title: Periodic Table
periodictable.description: Periodic Table retrieves chemical element data by element name or symbol. Responses include atomic number, category, phase, block, standard group and period positions, and CPK hex colors, with paid plans adding atomic mass and thermal metrics.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the chemical element to get information about. US and IUPAC spellings (aluminum or aluminium, cesium or caesium, sulfur or sulphur) and atomic numbers (26) are accepted

permutationcombination.title: Permutation & Combination Calculator
permutationcombination.description: Calculate permutations (P(n,r)) and combinations (C(n,r)) for any given values of n and r.

params.name: n
params.description: Total number of items

params.name: r
params.description: Number of items to choose (must be <= n)

phishingcheck.title: Phishing Domain Checker
phishingcheck.description: Phishing Domain Checker is a phishing detection API that verifies whether a domain or URL appears in a comprehensive database of known phishing sites. Updated every 6 hours from three independent blocklists covering about 700,000 phishing domains.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to check (e.g., example.com). To check a raw IP host, send it through the url endpoint (e.g., http://1.2.3.4/)

phonenumbervalidator.title: Phone Number Validator
phonenumbervalidator.description: Phone Number Validator checks a phone number and returns whether it is valid, its line type, country, area and time zone, and the carrier its mobile range was allocated to. It flags disposable and VoIP numbers and outputs E.164, international, national and RFC3966 formats.

params.name: number
params.description: The phone number to validate

params.name: country
params.description: The two-letter country code of the phone number (e.g., us, uk). Optional when the number is in international format starting with + or 00

phonetic.title: Phonetic Encoder
phonetic.description: Phonetic Encoder generates phonetic codes for words using Soundex and Metaphone algorithms. These codes represent how words sound, enabling fuzzy matching of similar-sounding names.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to encode phonetically

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Algorithm to use

pictionary.title: Pictionary Generator
pictionary.description: Pictionary Generator creates random drawing prompts filtered by difficulty level for the classic Pictionary sketching game.

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level

params.name: count
params.description: Number of words to generate

piglatin.title: Pig Latin
piglatin.description: Pig Latin translates English text into Pig Latin while preserving designated words from transformation. Pass any sentence along with an optional exclusion list to receive the encoded phrase and confirmed skipped terms.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode in Pig Latin

params.name: exclusions
params.description: Words to exclude from encoding

pinger.title: Domain and IP Pinger
pinger.description: Domain and IP Pinger checks whether any domain name or public IP address is reachable and responding in real time. It returns an alive status and successful round trips, while paid plans add packet loss percentages and latency metrics.

params.name: host
params.description: The host name or public IP that you want to ping. A URL (https://example.com/path) or host:port is reduced to its host

params.name: timeout
params.description: The timeout for the ping request in milliseconds

params.name: roundTrips
params.description: How many pings to send before averaging the round-trip time

placeholdertext.title: Placeholder Text Generator
placeholdertext.description: Placeholder Text Generator creates custom placeholder text and dummy copy across themes like lorem ipsum, tech, and corporate. Set the paragraph count, sentences per paragraph, and style to receive an array of generated text blocks.

params.name: style
params.description: The style of placeholder text

params.name: paragraphs
params.description: Number of paragraphs to generate

params.name: sentences
params.description: Number of sentences per paragraph

planetpositions.title: Planet Positions
planetpositions.description: Planet Positions locates solar system bodies for any observer coordinates on Earth. It checks if the sun, moon, or planets sit below the horizon, while paid plans add celestial coordinates and distance.

params.name: date
params.description: The date to get planetary position data for (MM-DD-YYYY). An ISO date-time such as 2026-11-17T20:00:00 is also accepted and supplies the time; with Z or an offset it is read as that exact instant

params.name: time
params.description: The time of day for the calculation (HH:mm, 24-hour; HH:mm:ss and 12-hour times such as 9:00 PM are also accepted, seconds are ignored), read as UTC unless timezone is given. Defaults to 00:00 if not provided

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone to read the date and time in, such as America/Los_Angeles. Defaults to UTC

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the observer

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the observer

params.name: alt
params.description: The altitude of the observer in meters

params.name: planet
params.description: The planet to get position data for

platinumprice.title: Platinum Price
platinumprice.description: Platinum Price retrieves real-time spot rates for platinum per troy ounce, gram, and kilogram. Each response reports prices in USD, 24-hour net price changes, direction markers, and update timestamps; paid plans add 172 currencies, 7- and 30-day changes, 30-day stats, and hourly and daily history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

params.name: daily
params.description: Include the daily closing price per ounce for the last 30 days

population.title: Population Data
population.description: A country population and demographic data API. Look up any country by ISO code to get its population data, with total population, world population rank and share, growth rate, density, urban/rural breakdown, and life expectancy on paid plans.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2 or 3-letter country code (e.g., US, USA, GB, GBR). UK is accepted for GB

params.name: year
params.description: Specific year to retrieve data for (1960-present). Returns latest if not specified.

portnumberlookup.title: Port Number Lookup
portnumberlookup.description: Port Number Lookup identifies network services and port ranges from any port number or service name. Each query returns the assigned service, description, and classification across well-known, registered, or dynamic ranges, while paid plans add protocol details.

params.name: port
params.description: Port number to lookup

profanityfilter.title: Profanity Filter
profanityfilter.description: Profanity Filter is a bad word filter API that scans text for offensive language and masks detected swear words with a chosen replacement character. It returns the sanitized text and a boolean flag indicating if profanity was present. Paid plans add the count of filtered words, each matched word with its position, and custom allow and block word lists.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to filter profanity words from

params.name: mask
params.description: The mask to replace the profanity words with. Should be a Single Character (e.g., *)

params.name: details
params.description: Add a matches list with each filtered word and its start and end position

params.name: allow
params.description: Comma-separated words the filter should not flag, up to 100 single words (e.g. hell,damn)

params.name: add
params.description: Comma-separated extra words to flag and mask, up to 100 single words

punycode.title: Punycode Converter
punycode.description: Convert between Unicode and Punycode for internationalized domain names (IDN).

params.name: text
