params.description: Unicode label, domain, email address or URL to encode; only the domain of an email or the host of a URL is converted (max 1000 characters)

params.name: mode
params.description: encode or decode; when omitted, an all-ASCII input with an xn-- label is decoded and anything else is encoded

purchasingpower.title: Purchasing Power
purchasingpower.description: Purchasing Power calculates the inflation-adjusted value of money between any two time periods. Find out what $100 from 1990 is worth today, or calculate real returns on investments accounting for inflation.

params.name: amount
params.description: The dollar amount to convert (0 to 1,000,000,000,000)

params.name: from
params.description: Starting period: a year (YYYY, priced at January of that year) or a month (YYYY-MM). Data available from 1913-01

params.name: to
params.description: Ending period: a year (YYYY, priced at January) or a month (YYYY-MM). Omit for the latest published month

qrcodegenerator.title: QR Code Generator
qrcodegenerator.description: QR Code Generator creates customizable QR codes with support for colors, gradients, logos, and various styling options. Generate professional QR codes for marketing, packaging, and digital experiences.

params.name: value
params.description: The text or data to encode in the QR code. For type=wifi, the network name (SSID) with password and encryption, or a full payload like T:WPA;S:MyNetwork;P:secret;;. For type=vcard, a contact name, vCard property lines (FN:, TEL:, EMAIL:) or a full BEGIN:VCARD card

params.name: type
params.description: The type of data being encoded. Advanced types (wifi, vcard) are premium.

params.name: password
params.description: Wi-Fi password when type=wifi and value is the network name

params.name: encryption
params.description: Wi-Fi security when type=wifi: WPA (default when a password is given, covers WPA2), WEP, or nopass for an open network

params.name: hidden
params.description: Set true when the Wi-Fi network does not broadcast its name (type=wifi)

params.name: format
params.description: Output format. Vector formats (svg, webp) are premium.

params.name: size
params.description: Size of the QR code in pixels (50-2048)

params.name: margin
params.description: Margin around the QR code in pixels (0-100)

params.name: color
params.description: Foreground color as hex code (e.g., #000000)

params.name: backgroundColor
params.description: Background color as hex code (e.g., #ffffff)

params.name: dotStyle
params.description: Style of QR code dots

params.name: cornerSquareStyle
params.description: Style of corner squares

params.name: cornerDotStyle
params.description: Style of corner dots

params.name: gradient
params.description: Gradient configuration with type (linear, radial) and colorStops array

params.name: logo
params.description: URL of logo image to place in center of QR code

params.name: logoSize
params.description: Size of logo relative to QR code (0.1-0.5)

params.name: logoMargin
params.description: Margin around logo in pixels

qrcodereader.title: QR Code Reader
qrcodereader.description: QR Code Reader is a QR code scanner API that decodes text and web links from uploaded QR code images. Send a JPG, PNG, or GIF file up to 10 MB to retrieve the raw encoded payload, with paid plans adding corner coordinates.

querystringbuilder.title: Query String Builder
querystringbuilder.description: Query String Builder converts JSON objects into properly formatted URL query strings with optional encoding.

params.name: params
params.description: JSON object of parameters

params.name: encode
params.description: URL encode parameter values

randomfacts.title: Random Facts
randomfacts.description: Random Facts is a fun facts API that delivers a random fact on every request without requiring any query parameters. Drop bite-sized trivia into apps, chat widgets, and daily notification feeds.

randomgenerator.title: Random Data Generator
randomgenerator.description: Random Data Generator is a random data API that produces random numbers in any range (whole or decimal, with or without repeats), dice of any size, coin flips, booleans, random strings, UUIDs, and mock names, emails, addresses and dates for application testing. Numbers, dice, coins, booleans and strings come from a cryptographically secure generator. Paid plans can generate batches up to 100 items.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of random data to generate

params.name: count
params.description: The number of random data to generate (1 to 100)

params.name: includeAvatar
params.description: Include an AI-generated face avatar (only applies when type=name)

params.name: min
params.description: Smallest number to draw, inclusive (type=number). Defaults to 0

params.name: max
params.description: Largest number to draw, inclusive (type=number). Defaults to 999999

params.name: decimals
params.description: Decimal places for type=number (0 to 10); 0 draws whole numbers

params.name: unique
params.description: Draw without repeats (type=number with whole numbers, or type=dice)

params.name: sides
params.description: Number of sides on each die for type=dice (2 to 1000)

params.name: length
params.description: Length of each value for type=string (1 to 256)

params.name: charset
params.description: Characters for type=string

randomidentitygenerator.title: Random Identity Generator
randomidentitygenerator.description: Random Identity Generator creates synthetic user profiles with realistic names, usernames, email addresses, phone numbers, and gender attributes. Paid plans add batch generation, birthdates, company details, and AI-generated avatars.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of identities to create

params.name: includeAvatar
params.description: Include an AI-generated face avatar for each identity

randomjoke.title: Random Joke
randomjoke.description: Random Joke fetches two-part jokes with separated setups and punchlines for applications and bots. Paid plans add a joke rating score to evaluate humor.

params.name: safe
params.description: Only return jokes reviewed as safe for a general audience (no sexual, offensive, violent or political jokes). Set to false to include the full collection, which has adult humor

randompun.title: Random Pun
randompun.description: Random Pun retrieves a random pun and its topic category on every request. Each call supplies the full pun text, with paid plans adding an additional humor rating score.

randomquote.title: Random Quote
randomquote.description: Random Quote fetches a random quote and its author attribution on every call. Send a GET request without parameters to receive quote text ready for displays, dashboards, or daily messages.

randomusergenerator.title: Random User Generator
randomusergenerator.description: Random User Generator produces realistic mock user profiles complete with full names, email addresses, usernames, birth dates, and phone numbers. Paid plans add batch generation, random passwords, and matching AI avatars.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of users to generate

params.name: includeAvatar
params.description: Include an AI-generated face avatar matching user's gender and age

params.name: gender
params.description: Only generate users of this gender

params.name: nationality
params.description: ISO country code for localised names, phone numbers and addresses (e.g. DE, JP, BR). Defaults to US

params.name: seed
params.description: Any string; the same seed (with the same other parameters) returns the same users, for repeatable test data

randomwords.title: Random Word
randomwords.description: Random Word is a random word generator API that selects a random English word from the dictionary on each request. Paid plans add dictionary definitions and ARPABET phonetic pronunciation.

readabilityscore.title: Text Readability Score
readabilityscore.description: Text Readability Score calculates the readability score and grade level of any text across standard formulas. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, Coleman-Liau, syllable and word counts, an average grade level, and a target audience label.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to calculate the readability score of

readingtime.title: Reading Time Calculator
readingtime.description: Reading Time Calculator estimates how long it will take to read a given text. It calculates reading time based on word count and customizable reading speed (WPM).

params.name: text
params.description: The text to calculate reading time for

params.name: wpm
params.description: Words per minute reading speed

recipe.title: Recipe Generator
recipe.description: Recipe Generator creates complete cooking recipes from a dish title or meal idea. Pass any dish name to get structured ingredients with quantities, step-by-step instructions, prep time, cook time, and serving counts.

params.name: name
params.description: The name or description of the recipe you want to generate

regextester.title: Regex Tester
regextester.description: Regex Tester tests regular expressions against input strings across operations like match, search, replace, and split. It reports compilation validity, syntax error details, execution timing, and structural pattern analysis.

params.name: pattern
params.description: The regular expression pattern to test. Maximum 500 characters

params.name: text
params.description: The text to test the pattern against. Maximum 20000 characters

params.name: flags
params.description: Regex flags: g (global), i (case insensitive), m (multiline), s (dotall), u (unicode), y (sticky)

params.name: test_type
params.description: Operation type

params.name: replacement
params.description: Replacement text for 'replace' operation

relativetimeformatter.title: Relative Time Formatter
relativetimeformatter.description: Relative Time Formatter converts Unix timestamps and ISO dates into readable relative time phrases. Choose between short, long, or abbreviated styles to get humanized past or future strings, millisecond differences, and unit breakdowns from seconds to years.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds

params.name: reference
params.description: Date or ISO 8601 date-time to compare against (default: current time). A time and offset are used; a date alone is midnight UTC

params.name: style
params.description: Output style

removepunctuation.title: Remove Punctuation
removepunctuation.description: Remove Punctuation strips punctuation marks from any submitted text string and returns the cleaned text. Paid plans add the total count and a list of every punctuation character removed.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to remove punctuation from

params.name: replacement
params.description: What removed punctuation becomes: none (deleted, the default) or space, so well-known becomes well known instead of wellknown. Apostrophes inside words are always deleted (don't becomes dont)

params.name: keepNumbers
params.description: Keep periods, commas and colons that sit between two digits, so 3.14, 1,000 and 5:30 survive; they are not counted as removed

reversednslookup.title: Reverse DNS Lookup
reversednslookup.description: Reverse DNS Lookup resolves IPv4 and IPv6 addresses into their associated hostnames via PTR records. Pass any IP address to check if reverse records exist and receive all matching hostnames.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to lookup (IPv4 or IPv6)

reversegeocode.title: Reverse Geocode
reversegeocode.description: Reverse Geocode converts latitude and longitude coordinates into US, Canada and Australia location details. Pass geographic coordinates to retrieve the corresponding city, state, postal code, country code, time zone and US county. Paid plans can add the point's geohash, plus code and degrees-minutes-seconds notation.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the coordinates

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the coordinates

params.name: geocodes
params.description: Add a geocodes object with the point's geohash, plus code (Open Location Code) and degrees-minutes-seconds notation

reversetext.title: Reverse Text
reversetext.description: Reverse Text transforms text by reversing characters, words, or lines with multiple reversal modes for different use cases.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to reverse

params.name: mode
params.description: Reversal mode

ringsizeconverter.title: Ring Size Converter
ringsizeconverter.description: Ring Size Converter translates international ring sizes or millimeter diameters into US and UK standards, inside diameter, and circumference. Paid plans add equivalent sizes for Europe, Japan, Switzerland, and Australia.

params.name: size
params.description: The ring size to convert. Numbers accept decimals and fractions (6.5, 6 1/2, 6½); UK and AU letters accept half sizes (N½, N 1/2)

params.name: from
params.description: Source region

rockpaperscissors.title: Rock Paper Scissors
rockpaperscissors.description: Rock Paper Scissors API simulates the classic hand game with detailed outcome analysis, statistics, and support for multiple rounds.

params.name: choice
params.description: Your choice - omit for random

params.name: rounds
params.description: Number of rounds to play

romanconverter.title: Roman Numeral Converter
romanconverter.description: Roman Numeral Converter is a bidirectional tool for converting between Arabic numbers (1-3999) and Roman numerals. It provides detailed breakdowns of the conversion process.

params.name: number
params.description: The number to convert to Roman numerals

romannumeralmath.title: Roman Numeral Math
romannumeralmath.description: Roman Numeral Math computes addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division between two Roman numerals. It returns the calculated result and complete equation in both Roman numeral and standard integer formats.

params.name: roman1
params.description: The first Roman numeral

params.name: roman2
params.description: The second Roman numeral

params.name: operation
params.description: Operation to perform

routinglookup.title: Routing Number Lookup
routinglookup.description: Routing Number Lookup is a bank routing number lookup and validation API for US ABA numbers. It checks the check digit, finds the bank name and state, identifies the routing type and Federal Reserve district, and says whether the number takes FedACH payments and Fedwire transfers, while paid plans add full street addresses, branch details, Fedwire and ACH directory details, and replacement numbers.

params.name: routing
params.description: The routing number to lookup information about. Dashes, dots and spaces are ignored (021-000-021)

rsstojson.title: RSS to JSON
rsstojson.description: RSS to JSON converts any RSS feed URL into structured JSON in real time. Each response returns the source domain, article counts, headlines, publication dates, summaries, and direct article links.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the RSS feed you want converted into JSON format

salestax.title: Sales Tax Lookup
salestax.description: Sales Tax Lookup is a US sales tax rate API: send a ZIP or ZIP+4 code or a two-letter state code and get the current combined sales tax rate, city and state back as JSON. Paid plans add the state, county, city and special district rates that make it up, and whether the state taxes at origin or destination.

params.name: zip
params.description: The zip code for which you want to get the sales tax rate. ZIP+4 (64082-1234) is accepted and priced at its 5-digit ZIP; a ZIP that lost its leading zero (2108) is read as 02108

salestaxcalculator.title: Sales Tax Calculator
salestaxcalculator.description: Sales Tax Calculator is a US sales tax calculation API: send an order amount with a ZIP code or state and get the combined rate, the tax amount and the order total back as JSON. Paid plans split both the rate and the tax amount by state, county, city and special district.

params.name: amount
params.description: Purchase amount to calculate tax on (0 to 1,000,000,000,000)

params.name: zip
params.description: Valid US 5-digit ZIP code (required unless state is given). ZIP+4 (64082-1234) is accepted and priced at its 5-digit ZIP. If both zip and state are given, zip wins and state is ignored

params.name: state
params.description: 2-letter US state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX); used when zip is not given, state rate only

sanctionscreening.title: Sanctions Screening
sanctionscreening.description: Sanctions Screening is an OFAC API that checks a person, company or vessel name against the US Treasury OFAC SDN and Consolidated lists, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list and the UK Sanctions List. It returns scored JSON matches with the list each hit came from, aliases, dates of birth, addresses and sanctions programs so you can decide whether to block or review.

params.name: name
params.description: The person or company name to screen (3-300 characters, at most 15 words). Latin, Cyrillic and Greek are fuzzy-matched; other scripts match native-script list aliases

params.name: threshold
params.description: Minimum match score to return, between 0.5 and 1. Lower catches more names but returns more false positives. Values outside the range are clamped to 0.5 or 1

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-50; values outside the range are clamped)

params.name: type
params.description: Restrict screening to one entry type: individual, entity, vessel or aircraft. Any other value is ignored and every type is screened

params.name: lists
params.description: Comma-separated list codes to screen (ofac_sdn, ofac_cons, un, eu, uk). Omit to screen every list. Unknown codes are ignored, and if none of the codes is valid every list is screened

savingsbonds.title: I-Bond Rates
savingsbonds.description: I-Bond Rates provides current and historical interest rates for US Series I Savings Bonds. I-Bonds are inflation-protected savings bonds with a composite rate made up of a fixed rate plus an inflation rate that adjusts every 6 months. Looking up an issue period also returns what a bond bought then earns today, from its fixed rate and the inflation rate at its latest six-month reset.

params.name: period
params.description: Specific issue period to lookup (YYYY-MM format, e.g., 2022-05). Returns that period's issue rates plus what a bond issued then earns today. Omit for current rates.

scrabblescorer.title: Scrabble Word Scorer
scrabblescorer.description: Scrabble Word Scorer calculates the official Scrabble score for any word across five languages. It provides the total base points, letter count, and point values for each individual letter.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to score

params.name: language
params.description: Scrabble language variant

secfilings.title: SEC Filings
secfilings.description: SEC Filings returns the recent EDGAR filing history for a US public company by ticker - 10-K annual reports, 10-Q quarterlies, 8-K current reports, Form 4 insider filings, S-1 registrations and more - each with its filing date, form type and a direct link to the document, plus derived filing-activity analytics calculated for you.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ADBE)

params.name: form
params.description: Filter to a single form type (e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of filings to return (1-50). Defaults to 5.

sentimentanalysis.title: Sentiment Analysis
sentimentanalysis.description: Sentiment Analysis evaluates the emotional tone of any text string. It returns an AFINN valence score, a comparative word-normalized score, and a five-tier sentiment label from very negative to very positive. Paid plans add sentence-level labels from a transformer model, a mixed-sentiment flag, magnitude, and the words that drove the score.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to analyze the sentiment of

seoscraper.title: SEO Data Scraper
seoscraper.description: SEO Data Scraper parses any public URL to collect title tags, meta descriptions, robots directives, and Open Graph or Twitter card previews. Paid plans add canonical URLs to verify indexing rules.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to scrape SEO data from (a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com; https:// is assumed when no scheme is given)

seovalidator.title: SEO Quick Validator
seovalidator.description: SEO Quick Validator inspects live web pages for on-page SEO errors and tag issues. Pass any URL to inspect title lengths, meta descriptions, H1 headings, viewport and canonical tags, image alt text, and unverified external links.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to validate the SEO metrics of

shoesizeconverter.title: Shoe Size Converter
shoesizeconverter.description: Shoe Size Converter translates footwear measurements across regional standards, including US, UK, Australian, European, Mexican, Korean and Japanese sizing systems. Provide a size, source region, and gender category to get US, UK and Australian equivalents, with paid plans adding European, Mexican, Korean, Japanese, and centimeter measurements.

params.name: size
params.description: The shoe size to convert: a number, a fraction (9 1/2, 9½, EU 42 2/3), or a US kids size with its suffix (11C toddler/little kid, 5Y big kid; W or M picks the adult scale)

params.name: from
params.description: Source region

params.name: gender
params.description: Gender sizing

shortcodegenerator.title: Short Code Generator
shortcodegenerator.description: Short Code Generator creates custom alphanumeric short codes for vouchers, referral tokens, and redirect slugs. Specify a length, batch count, and character set like numeric, hex, or Base58 to receive an array of random strings.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of codes to generate. Codes are unique within one response; uniqueness across calls is up to you

params.name: length
params.description: Length of each code

params.name: charset
params.description: Character set. uppercase is A-Z and 0-9; unambiguous is uppercase without 0, O, 1, I or L, for printed vouchers people retype

silverprice.title: Silver Price
silverprice.description: Silver Price quotes spot silver prices per troy ounce, gram, and kilogram in US dollars, including 24-hour price change and trend direction. Paid plans add 172 currencies, 24-hour highs and lows, 7- and 30-day changes, 30-day stats, and hourly and 30-day daily history.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to get the price in

params.name: hourly
params.description: Include hourly price data for the past 24 hours

params.name: daily
params.description: Include the daily closing price per ounce for the last 30 days

sitemapgenerator.title: Sitemap Generator
sitemapgenerator.description: Sitemap Generator is a website sitemap generator API that creates valid XML sitemaps from URL lists following the sitemaps.org protocol for search engine optimization.

params.name: urls
params.description: Array of URLs (strings or objects with url, priority, changeFreq, lastMod). Non-ASCII paths are percent-encoded and international domains punycoded; exact duplicates are dropped

params.name: baseUrl
params.description: Base URL to prepend to relative paths

params.name: changeFreq
params.description: Default change frequency

params.name: priority
params.description: Default priority

params.name: includeLastMod
params.description: Include lastmod dates in sitemap. URLs without their own lastMod are stamped with the request date, so pass false when you have no real modification dates

slotmachine.title: Slot Machine Simulator
slotmachine.description: Slot Machine Simulator generates slot machine reel spins for configurable reels, bet sizes, and spin counts. Every run outputs symbol names and emoji for each reel; paid plans add payout calculations, win tracking, and net profit statistics.

params.name: spins
params.description: Number of spins to simulate

params.name: reels
params.description: Number of reels

params.name: bet
params.description: Bet amount per spin, rounded to 2 decimal places

slugify.title: Slugify
slugify.description: Slugify converts text into clean, URL-friendly slugs with custom separators and optional lowercase formatting. Pass any raw string to get back the original text and its normalized slug with accents stripped and spaces replaced.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to convert to a slug

params.name: separator
params.description: The separator character

params.name: lowercase
params.description: Convert to lowercase (default: true)

solarpotential.title: Solar Potential
solarpotential.description: Solar Potential calculates solar energy potential for any latitude and longitude coordinates. It returns average daily usable sunlight hours and optimal panel orientation, with paid plans adding yearly totals and cloud factors.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the location

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the location

spamdetector.title: Spam Detector
spamdetector.description: Spam Detector is a spam detection API that evaluates text submissions to determine whether content is likely spam. Pass a message body and an optional sender email to check for spam patterns, with paid plans adding IP blocklist and disposable email checks.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to detect spam in

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to validate against the spam database. This is optional

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to validate against the spam database.  This is optional

spellchecker.title: Spell Checker
spellchecker.description: Spell Checker flags misspelled words in submitted English text and generates correction suggestions. It counts total spelling errors, lists possible replacements for each mistaken word, and can return the text with the top suggestions applied, plus on paid plans the character offsets of every misspelling.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to check the spelling of

params.name: autocorrect
params.description: Include correctedText, the submitted text with each misspelling replaced by its first suggestion

params.name: offsets
params.description: Include the start and end character position of every occurrence of each misspelled word

spellingbee.title: Spelling Bee Generator
spellingbee.description: Spelling Bee Generator creates word puzzles with 7 letters where players form words using a required center letter.

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty: easy, medium, hard (affects word count)

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

spfvalidator.title: SPF Validator
spfvalidator.description: SPF Validator checks the Sender Policy Framework (SPF) DNS record for a domain to verify if it’s valid and optionally whether a given IP address is authorized to send emails for that domain.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to validate the SPF record for

sqlexplainer.title: SQL Explainer
sqlexplainer.description: SQL Explainer analyzes SQL queries and provides clear, plain English explanations of what they do. Perfect for learning SQL, code reviews, or documentation.

params.name: query
params.description: The SQL query to explain

params.name: detail
params.description: Explanation detail level: brief, standard, or detailed

srvparser.title: SRV Record Parser
srvparser.description: SRV Record Parser analyzes DNS SRV records and extracts service location information including priority, weight, port, and target server details.

params.name: record
params.description: The SRV record string to parse. A full record set, one record per line, is accepted; the top-level fields describe the first record and records/priority_groups cover all of them

sslchecker.title: SSL Certificate Checker
sslchecker.description: SSL Checker is an SSL certificate API that connects to a website and checks its live certificate in seconds. It returns the certificate details, whether the chain verifies to a trusted root and matches the hostname, the negotiated TLS version and cipher, HSTS and OCSP stapling, plus expiry signals: valid or expired, days until expiry, expiring soon and self-signed.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain of the website to check the SSL certificate of. www.example.com and example.com are checked as separate hosts, since they often serve different certificates

starslookup.title: Stars Lookup
starslookup.description: Stars Lookup retrieves physical and positional stellar data by star name or astronomical classification. Query individual stars or filter by spectral class to obtain mass in kilograms, distance in light-years, and stellar type.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the star (e.g., Sirius). IAU proper names (Rigil Kentaurus), Bayer designations (Alpha Orionis or alf Ori), Flamsteed numbers (58 Ori), HD and HIP numbers (HD 48915) and common names (Sun, North Star) are also accepted

stateboundaries.title: State Boundaries
stateboundaries.description: State Boundaries provides GeoJSON data and Census identifiers for US states using a two-letter postal code. Responses include the state name, FIPS code, and GEOID; paid plans add border polygon coordinates and land area measurements.

params.name: state
params.description: The state: a two-letter code (CA) or the full name (California)

stockexchange.title: Stock Exchange
stockexchange.description: Stock Exchange identifies trading venues worldwide by Market Identifier Code, name, or country. It provides official exchange names, acronyms, host cities, websites, and founding dates, while paid plans add regulatory MIC and LEI identifiers.

params.name: mic
params.description: The 4-character Market Identifier Code (e.g., XNYS for NYSE, XNAS for NASDAQ)

stockmarketopentimes.title: Stock Market Open Times
stockmarketopentimes.description: Stock Market Open Times checks if a global stock exchange is currently trading and provides its opening and closing times. Pass an exchange code like NYSE or LSE to get current open status (open, closed, weekend or holiday), the holiday name, official exchange name, and session hours. On paid plans, add schedule=true for the exchange's local time, half-day early closes, and the next open and close with a countdown in minutes.

params.name: exchange
params.description: The stock exchange code (e.g., NYSE, LSE, NSE). ISO 10383 MIC codes such as XNYS, XNAS, XLON, XETR and XTKS, and aliases such as XETRA and NYSEARCA, are accepted and answered under the venue's own code

params.name: schedule
params.description: Include local time, half-day early close, next open and close, and minutes until the next change

streetaddressparser.title: Street Address Parser
streetaddressparser.description: Street Address Parser is an address parsing API that breaks raw US street addresses into structured location components. Pass any single-line address string to extract the building number, directional, street name, street type, unit, city, state abbreviation, and postal code. Set standardize=true to get the address type (street, PO box or intersection) free, and on paid plans the mailing-format delivery line, last line and ZIP+4.

params.name: address
params.description: The street address to parse

params.name: standardize
params.description: Add a standardized block: the address type, plus on paid plans the delivery line, last line and ZIP+4

subdomainfinder.title: Subdomain Finder
subdomainfinder.description: Subdomain Finder discovers active subdomains and their resolved IP addresses for any target domain. It checks certificate transparency logs and common hostnames, returning matched hostnames, root A records, and scan completion status.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain you want to find all the available subdomains for (e.g. google.com)

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of subdomains to detect

params.name: deepScan
params.description: Search the full wordlist instead of only certificate transparency and common names. Slower, and may still report complete: false when the time limit is reached

sudoku.title: Sudoku Generator
sudoku.description: Sudoku Generator creates 9x9 Sudoku puzzle grids across multiple difficulty settings, returned as an 81-character row-major string with "-" for empty cells, plus a ready-to-render HTML table and an image. Paid plans add the full solution grid for validation or hints.

params.name: difficulty
params.description: The difficulty level of the Sudoku puzzle to generate

sunposition.title: Sun Position
sunposition.description: Sun Position calculates the sun altitude and azimuth, plus compass bearing, for any geographic coordinates and time. Provide latitude and longitude to read sun elevation angles and daylight status; paid plans add panel aiming angles and shadow ratios.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the location

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the location

params.name: date
params.description: The date to get the sun position data for (MM-DD-YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD). An ISO date-time such as 2026-06-21T13:30:00 is also accepted and supplies the time; with Z or an offset it is read as that exact instant. Years 1700 to 2300 are supported

params.name: time
params.description: The time of day for the calculation (HH:mm, 24-hour; HH:mm:ss and 12-hour times such as 1:30 PM are also accepted, seconds are ignored), read in the timezone of the coordinates. Defaults to 00:00 if not provided

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone to read the date and time in, such as America/Los_Angeles. Defaults to the timezone of the coordinates

sunrisesunset.title: Sunrise Sunset
sunrisesunset.description: Sunrise Sunset calculates exact sunrise and sunset times, twilight stages, and golden hour windows for any latitude and longitude coordinates. Paid plans can specify custom dates and receive solar noon. With local=true, the response names the IANA timezone of the coordinates on any plan, and paid plans also get each time in local time with its UTC offset.

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude of the location

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude of the location

params.name: date
params.description: The date for which you want to get the sunrise and sunset times (e.g., MM-DD-YYYY : 01-01-2022)

params.name: local
params.description: Also return the timezone of the coordinates and every time in local time

superheroname.title: Superhero Name Generator
superheroname.description: Generate unique superhero names using dynamic templates and word combinations.

params.name: style
params.description: Name style

svgconverter.title: SVG Converter
svgconverter.description: SVG Converter is an SVG to PNG API that transforms vector SVG files into raster image formats. Convert SVG logos, icons, and illustrations to PNG, JPG, or WebP for use in applications that don't support vector graphics.

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: Target format

params.name: quality
params.description: Output quality (applies to jpg/webp)

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum width in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Maximum height in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

swiftlookup.title: SWIFT Code Lookup
swiftlookup.description: SWIFT Code Lookup identifies the bank institution, branch, city, and country code behind any SWIFT or BIC code. Search by code or query by bank name to verify matching financial institutions and branch locations.

params.name: swift
params.description: The SWIFT code to lookup information about. A partial code of at least 4 characters matches every code it prefixes

params.name: country
params.description: Optional. Keep only codes in this country: an ISO two-letter code (US) or the country name (United States)

syllablecounter.title: Syllable Counter
syllablecounter.description: Syllable Counter counts syllables across any submitted text string up to 500 characters. It returns the total syllable count, total word count, and average syllables per word.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to count syllables in (max 500 characters)

taxidvalidator.title: Tax ID Validator
taxidvalidator.description: Tax ID Validator checks US tax identification numbers including SSNs, EINs, and ITINs for structural validity. It accepts formatted or unformatted strings and returns validation results, normalized formatting, masked numbers, and the last four digits.

params.name: taxid
params.description: The US Tax ID to validate (SSN, EIN, or ITIN format)

params.name: type
params.description: Optional: skip auto-detection and validate as this type (ssn, ein or itin). Use it for unformatted EINs, which otherwise read as SSNs

techstackdetector.title: Website Tech Stack Detector
techstackdetector.description: Website Tech Stack Detector identifies the technologies a website runs on, such as its CMS, ecommerce platform, JavaScript framework, analytics, CDN and hosting, with categories and a confidence score for each. Paid plans add detected versions, CPE identifiers and a rendered mode that runs the page's JavaScript.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website to analyze (a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com; https:// is assumed when no scheme is given)

params.name: render
params.description: Load the page in a headless browser first, to find technologies added by JavaScript and read JavaScript globals. Slower

tenseconverter.title: Tense Converter
tenseconverter.description: Tense Converter rewrites text into past, present or future tense. Submit any passage with your chosen target tense to receive the transformed wording and a flag indicating whether the text changed.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to convert to past, present or future tense

params.name: tense
params.description: The tense to convert the text to: past, present or future

textembeddings.title: Text Embeddings
textembeddings.description: Text Embeddings turns a sentence, paragraph or short document into a 384-dimension vector that captures its meaning, ready for semantic search, clustering, deduplication and recommendations. Send one text or a batch of up to 32, and add a compare text to get the cosine similarity of each one to it in the same call.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to embed, up to 10,000 characters. Send text or texts

params.name: texts
params.description: A JSON array of texts to embed in one call: up to 32 on paid plans and 4 on the Free plan, 10,000 characters each and 50,000 in total. Send text or texts

params.name: compare
params.description: Optional reference text; each embedding gets its cosine similarity to it

textlanguage.title: Text Language
textlanguage.description: Text Language is a language detection API that detects the language of any input string, returning the full language name and its two-letter ISO 639-1 code. Send plain text passages or short snippets to identify incoming multilingual content.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to detect the language of

textsimilarity.title: Text Similarity
textsimilarity.description: Text Similarity compares two text strings and calculates their percentage match score. It returns case-insensitive and case-sensitive similarity scores plus the count and proportion of differing words.

params.name: text1
params.description: The first text to compare. Must be less than 1000 characters

params.name: text2
params.description: The second text to compare. Must be less than 1000 characters

textstyler.title: Text Styler
textstyler.description: Text Styler converts plain text into styled text formats like bold, italic, script, fraktur, double-struck, bubble letters, strikethrough, typewriter, and vaporwave. Submit your string with a chosen style to receive the formatted text output.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to style

params.name: style
params.description: The style to apply

textsummarizer.title: Text Summarizer
textsummarizer.description: Text Summarizer condenses raw text into concise summaries of a specified sentence count. Pass up to 50,000 characters to extract key points into readable summaries, with paid plans adding word counts and summary-length metrics.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to summarize (up to 50,000 characters)

params.name: sentences
params.description: The length of the summary (number of sentences)

texttocolor.title: Text to Color
texttocolor.description: Text to Color converts color names and descriptive color text into hexadecimal color codes. CSS names, hex/rgb()/hsl() values and about 900 everyday color names such as burgundy, charcoal or navy blue resolve to their real color; other text is hashed to a stable color. Paid plans add RGB, HSL, and CMYK formats.

params.name: color
params.description: The text to convert the color from

texttoemoji.title: Text to Emoji
texttoemoji.description: Text to Emoji converts plain text strings into matching emoji representations. Send any word or phrase and receive the corresponding emoji characters.

params.name: text
params.description: The text you want converted into emojis

thesaurus.title: Thesaurus
thesaurus.description: Thesaurus finds synonyms and alternative terms for any word. Supply a single target word to receive an array of matching synonyms.

params.name: word
params.description: The word for which you want to get synonyms

tickernews.title: Ticker News
tickernews.description: Ticker News is a stock news API that returns the latest news stories about one ticker symbol: US stocks and ETFs, stocks on 18 international markets, cryptocurrencies, futures and currency pairs. Each story comes with its headline, link, source, publisher and publication time, and is tagged as directly about the company or as a related market story. Paid plans add story summaries, headline tone and more stories per call.

params.name: ticker
params.description: The ticker symbol to get news for, for example AAPL, BRK.B, 7203 or SHEL. A suffix such as BP.L, a coin pair such as BTC-USD, a contract such as CL=F or a currency pair such as EUR/USD picks that market.

params.name: market
params.description: The market of the listing, when the ticker trades in more than one: a two-letter market code, CRYPTO, FUTURES or FX. Defaults to the US listing.

params.name: relevance
params.description: direct returns only stories whose headline or summary names the company or ticker; all also returns the sector round-ups and peer stories the news feeds carry for the ticker.

params.name: since
params.description: Return only stories published at or after this date or date-time (ISO 8601), for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T14:00:00Z.

tickersymbols.title: Ticker Symbols
tickersymbols.description: Ticker Symbols identifies what a ticker symbol is and where it trades. Look up a symbol to get every listing that carries it across the US and 18 international stock markets, cryptocurrencies, futures and currency pairs, or find a stock symbol by company name. Every result carries its name, market, exchange, security type and asset class; paid plans add FIGI identifiers, SEC CIK numbers and fuller search results.

params.name: symbol
params.description: The ticker symbol to look up, for example AAPL, BRK.B, SHEL or 7203. Returns every listing with that symbol. A suffix such as BP.L, a coin pair such as BTC-USD or a contract such as CL=F narrows it to that market.

params.name: market
params.description: Keep only listings on this market: a two-letter market code, CRYPTO, FUTURES or FX for currency pairs.

params.name: assetClass
params.description: Keep only listings of this asset class.

timezonelookup.title: Timezone Lookup
timezonelookup.description: Timezone Lookup resolves a city, an IANA zone name or a latitude and longitude to its local time, UTC offset, and calendar date. Responses include 12-hour and 24-hour clocks plus the minute offset from GMT.

params.name: city
params.description: The city name for which you want to get the data (e.g., Harare). A name shared by several places resolves to the best-known one (London is London, UK); add a state, province or country after a comma to pick another (e.g., Portland, Maine, London, Ontario or Toronto, ON; Canadian and Australian abbreviations such as ON, QC, NSW and VIC are understood). Smaller cities (Plano, TX) and common former or local names (Bangalore, Bombay, NYC, Munchen) are found too

tipcalculator.title: Tip Calculator
tipcalculator.description: Tip Calculator computes tips and splits bill totals across group members. Pass a pre-tip bill amount, tip percentage, and group size to get the tip total, overall cost, and individual per-person shares.

params.name: amount
params.description: The bill amount before tip (max 1,000,000,000,000)

params.name: percentage
params.description: Tip percentage

params.name: people
params.description: Number of people to split the bill

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code for display

titlecapitalization.title: Title Case Converter
titlecapitalization.description: Title Case Converter formats text strings into specific editorial style guidelines and capitalization standards. Send raw headline text and a chosen rule set like APA, Chicago, or AP to receive properly capitalized copy.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to convert to title case

params.name: style
params.description: The case to convert the text to

tldlookup.title: TLD Lookup
tldlookup.description: TLD Lookup retrieves information about any top-level domain including its type (generic, country-code, sponsored) and the sponsoring organization responsible for managing it.

params.name: tld
params.description: The top-level domain to look up (with or without leading dot)

tlscheck.title: TLS Checker
tlscheck.description: TLS Checker tests which TLS protocol versions a server accepts by running a live handshake for each of TLS 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3. It reports the highest version, the cipher the server picks, whether the certificate validates, whether deprecated protocols are still exposed, a risk score and a letter grade from a published rubric.

params.name: domain
params.description: The host to check the TLS/SSL configuration for. It is probed exactly as given, so www.example.com and example.com are checked separately; a scheme or path is dropped

params.name: port
params.description: The port to connect to (usually 443 for HTTPS)

tordetect.title: Tor Node Detector
tordetect.description: Tor Node Detector is a Tor exit node checker API: send any IP address and it tells you whether that IP belongs to an active Tor exit node, so you can identify traffic originating from the anonymity network.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to check against the Tor exit node list

totpgenerator.title: TOTP Generator
totpgenerator.description: TOTP Generator creates time-based one-time passwords compatible with authenticator apps using standard TOTP algorithms.

params.name: secret
params.description: Base32-encoded shared secret

params.name: digits
params.description: Number of digits in token

params.name: period
params.description: Time period in seconds

params.name: algorithm
params.description: HMAC algorithm: SHA1 (default, what most authenticator apps use), SHA256 or SHA512

params.name: time
params.description: Unix time in seconds to use instead of now

tradebalance.title: Trade Balance
tradebalance.description: Trade Balance provides monthly US international trade data - exports, imports, and the resulting goods-and-services trade balance (deficit or surplus) on a Balance of Payments basis. Each month comes with the previous month's balance, and paid plans add month-on-month and year-on-year changes, rolling 12-month totals and the last 12 months.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM format for historical lookup. Omit for current data.

params.name: history
params.description: Include the 12 monthly readings ending at the returned month

params.name: changes
params.description: Include the previous month's balance, month-on-month and year-on-year changes and rolling 12-month totals

translator.title: Translator
translator.description: Translator is a language translation API that translates plain text or HTML into target languages using standard language codes. Submit any string with a target language code to receive the translated text, both language names, and the confirmed or auto-detected source language.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to translate

params.name: target
params.description: The language code to translate the text to (e.g., fr, es, de)

params.name: source
params.description: The language code of the text to translate (e.g., en). If left blank, language will be auto-detected

params.name: format
params.description: text (default) or html. With html, tags and attributes are kept and only the text between tags is translated; entities such as & are decoded and may be translated as words. Any other value returns 400

treasuryyields.title: Treasury Yields
treasuryyields.description: Treasury Yields provides current and historical US Treasury constant-maturity market yields across the full curve (1-month through 30-year), plus TIPS real yields. Every plan gets today's full nominal curve. Paid plans add history back to 2010, TIPS real yields, day-over-day changes, curve spreads, inversion flags, the curve's shape and breakeven inflation.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional month in YYYY-MM format, back to 2010-01; returns that month's closing curve. Omit for the latest daily curve.

params.name: type
params.description: Optional filter for a single point. Legacy security types: bills, notes, bonds, tips, frn. Or a maturity: 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1yr, 2yr, 3yr, 5yr, 7yr, 10yr, 20yr, 30yr. tips and frn are paid-plan values; on the free plan they return a null rate with a note

trivia.title: Trivia Generator
trivia.description: Trivia Generator is a trivia and quiz API that serves random trivia questions complete with multiple-choice options and the correct answer. Paid plans can filter questions across topics like history, science, geography, and pop culture.

params.name: category
params.description: The category of the trivia question

truthordare.title: Truth or Dare
truthordare.description: The Truth or Dare API generates random truth questions and dare challenges for the classic party game. Features 400+ unique prompts with per-API-key tracking to avoid repeats.

params.name: type
params.description: Prompt type: truth, dare, or random

params.name: adult
params.description: Include adult/spicy prompts

truthtable.title: Truth Table Generator
truthtable.description: Truth Table Generator creates complete truth tables for boolean expressions with support for AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR, implication (->) and biconditional (<->) operators.

params.name: expression
params.description: Boolean expression using A-Z variables and operators (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR, IMPLIES/->, IFF/XNOR/<->); adjacent variables such as AB mean AND

ulidgenerator.title: ULID Generator
ulidgenerator.description: ULID Generator creates Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers that order records chronologically. Pass an optional batch count and millisecond timestamp to produce 26-character collision-resistant unique IDs with format details.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of ULIDs to generate

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Custom timestamp in milliseconds (optional, uses current time if not specified)

unemployment.title: Unemployment Rate
unemployment.description: Unemployment Rate looks up labor statistics by two- or three-letter ISO country code. It returns the country name, reporting year, and record count, with paid plans adding historical annual rates. With changes=true it also returns whether unemployment rose or fell, and on paid plans the previous year and its rate, the 1- and 5-year change in percentage points, and the 5-year high, low and average.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO country code (2 or 3 letter). Examples: US, USA, DE, DEU, GB, GBR

params.name: year
params.description: Specific year to retrieve data for (1991-present). Returns latest if not specified.

params.name: changes
params.description: Include the change against the previous year, the 5-year change and the 5-year high, low and average rate

unicodeescape.title: Unicode Escape/Unescape
unicodeescape.description: Unicode Escape/Unescape converts text into Unicode escape sequences or restores escaped strings back into readable characters. Send any string to get the transformed text and total character count.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to escape; leading and trailing whitespace is escaped too

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

unicodelookup.title: Unicode Character Lookup
unicodelookup.description: Unicode Character Lookup is a Unicode lookup API that inspects any character, symbol or hex codepoint to find its decimal value, hex notation, and UTF-16 encoding. The response also identifies the character category and supplies names for emoji.

params.name: character
params.description: The Unicode character to lookup. Supply either character or codepoint.

params.name: codepoint
params.description: The Unicode codepoint in hex (e.g., '1F44B', 'U+1F44B' or '0x1F44B'); HTML entities (👋 or 👋) and JS/JSON escapes (\u{1F44B}, \uD83D\uDC4B) are accepted too. Supply either character or codepoint.

unitconverter.title: Unit Converter
unitconverter.description: Unit Converter converts values between 200 units across 24 measures, from length, mass and volume to speed, pressure, data size, energy and electrical units. Pass a numeric value with source and target units (codes such as lb or km/h, or everyday names such as pounds, mph or °F) to get the converted result and unit abbreviations. On paid plans, precision sets the decimal places and conversions=true adds the value in every unit of the same measure.

params.name: value
params.description: The value to convert

params.name: from
params.description: The unit to convert from: a code such as lb, km/h or C, or a common name, plural or abbreviation such as pounds, lbs, mph, feet, tbsp or °F (any casing)

params.name: to
params.description: The unit to convert to, in the same forms as from

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal places to round results to, between 0 and 10. Without it, results are rounded to 2 decimal places and results under 1 keep 4 significant figures

params.name: conversions
params.description: Also return the value converted into every unit of the same measure

universitylookup.title: University Lookup
universitylookup.description: University Lookup is a university search and academic domain API covering about 12,000 institutions worldwide. Search by name and country, or pass a domain or email address to learn whether it belongs to a university, and for US institutions get IPEDS details such as control, level and highest degree, while paid plans add enrollment, admission rate and tuition.

params.name: name
params.description: University name or words from it; abbreviations such as NYU, UCL or KAIST match too. The best match ranks first: University of Oxford before Oxford Brookes

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain to check, e.g. stanford.edu; subdomains match their institution

params.name: email
params.description: Email address to check; its domain is used

params.name: country
params.description: Country name or two-letter code

params.name: state
params.description: State or province (two-letter code in the US)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum universities to return (1-50)

unixtimestamp.title: Unix Timestamp Converter
unixtimestamp.description: Unix Timestamp Converter converts Unix timestamps into formatted dates and parses ISO 8601 strings back into epoch seconds. Responses break down dates into ISO 8601, RFC 2822, simple time strings, individual calendar components like year, month and hour, plus the day of the year. Paid plans add the ISO week, and an IANA timezone to also get the same moment in local time with its UTC offset, abbreviation and daylight saving flag.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp to convert

params.name: format
params.description: Timestamp format

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York) or a UTC/GMT-prefixed fixed offset (e.g. UTC+05:30) to also show the moment in, returned as a local block

urlencode.title: URL Encoder/Decoder
urlencode.description: URL Encoder/Decoder converts text into percent-encoded strings or decodes existing URL components back into plain text. Pass any string with an encode or decode action to receive the processed output and your original text.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode; leading and trailing whitespace is encoded too

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform

params.name: mode
params.description: component (default) percent-encodes spaces as %20 and leaves + alone; form follows application/x-www-form-urlencoded, encoding spaces as + and decoding + as a space

urllookup.title: URL Lookup
urllookup.description: URL Lookup resolves any web address to its hosting server IP address, country, and continent in real time. Paid plans add city, state, coordinates, timezone, and EU membership status.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL to lookup the location of. Without a scheme, https:// is assumed

urltitle.title: URL Title
urltitle.description: URL Title fetches the HTML title tag of any web page in real time from a target URL. Paid plans also retrieve an array of every H1 heading tag found on the page.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to get the title of; without a scheme, https:// is assumed

urltomarkdown.title: URL to Markdown
urltomarkdown.description: URL to Markdown converts any webpage URL into structured Markdown text. Each response delivers the page title, converted text, word count, and element counts, with paid plans adding optional link and image syntax.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the webpage to convert to Markdown; without a scheme, https:// is assumed

params.name: includeImages
params.description: Whether to include image references in the Markdown output

params.name: includeLinks
params.description: Whether to include hyperlinks in the Markdown output

urlunshortener.title: URL Unshortener
urlunshortener.description: URL Unshortener expands shortened links to reveal their final destination URL and destination domain. Send any short link to inspect the resolved address and redirect count; paid plans add the full redirect chain.

params.name: url
params.description: The shortened URL to unshorten; without a scheme, https:// is assumed

usbvendorlookup.title: USB Vendor Lookup
usbvendorlookup.description: USB Vendor Lookup allows you to identify USB device manufacturers and products by their vendor ID and product ID. It uses the Linux USB ID Repository, which contains thousands of USB vendor and product identifiers.

params.name: vendorid
params.description: The USB vendor ID in hex (e.g., 05AC for Apple). 0x046D, VID_046D, the Windows USB\VID_046D&PID_C52B form and lsusb 046d:c52b are accepted, and short hex is zero-padded

params.name: productid
params.description: The USB product ID in hex (optional). 0xC52B and PID_C52B are accepted; a product ID inside vendorid is used when this is omitted

useragentgenerator.title: User Agent Generator
useragentgenerator.description: User Agent Generator creates realistic user agent strings for desktop, mobile, and tablet devices. Each request outputs the complete string with parsed browser and operating system names and versions, while paid plans add engine and CPU details.

params.name: device
params.description: The device type: desktop, mobile (phones) or tablet

params.name: browser
params.description: Only user agents of this browser

params.name: os
params.description: Only user agents of this operating system. iPads send the macOS desktop user agent

useragentparser.title: User Agent Parser
useragentparser.description: User Agent Parser parses user agent strings to extract browser, operating system, and hardware details. It identifies device types, CPU architecture, and bot traffic, so you can run user agent detection on every incoming HTTP request.

params.name: ua
params.description: The user agent string to parse

usernamegenerator.title: Username Generator
usernamegenerator.description: Username Generator creates handle suggestions from a person's name or email address. It returns an array of suggested usernames based on the input, while paid plans can request multiple options at once.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address to generate usernames from. A plus tag (john+news@) is dropped, and dots, dashes or underscores in the local part split it into name parts

params.name: count
params.description: The number of usernames to generate

params.name: platform
params.description: Only suggest handles this platform accepts (length and characters)

params.name: maxLength
params.description: Longest handle to suggest (3 to 50); combined with platform, the shorter limit wins

usernameprofanity.title: Username Profanity
usernameprofanity.description: Username Profanity flags offensive or inappropriate usernames before they reach your database. Send any candidate handle to receive a clear true or false profanity check result; paid plans add the matched words and categories, reserved-name and contact-detail checks, a masked version of the username and a single allowed verdict.

params.name: username
params.description: The username to check if it is inappropriate or profane

utmconverter.title: UTM Coordinate Converter
utmconverter.description: UTM Coordinate Converter provides bidirectional conversion between UTM (Universal Transverse Mercator) coordinates and latitude/longitude using WGS84 datum.

params.name: direction
params.description: Conversion direction

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude (-90 to 90)

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude (-180 to 180)

uuidgenerator.title: UUID Generator
uuidgenerator.description: UUID Generator is a UUID generator API that produces random RFC 4122 version 4 UUIDs on demand. Request single IDs or batches in standard lowercase, uppercase, or strings without hyphens.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of UUIDs to generate

params.name: version
params.description: UUID version (only version 4 currently supported)

params.name: format
params.description: Output format

variablenameconverter.title: Variable Name Converter
variablenameconverter.description: Variable Name Converter transforms variable names between different naming conventions including camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, and kebab-case. Punctuation that cannot appear in an identifier, such as the parentheses in Order Total ($), separates words and is dropped, so spreadsheet headers convert cleanly.

params.name: variables
params.description: Array of variable names to convert (max 100). Every entry must be a string.

params.name: to
params.description: Target naming convention

vatrates.title: VAT Rates
vatrates.description: VAT Rates is a European VAT rates API: send a two-letter country code and get the current VAT rates for that country as JSON, with the full standard, reduced, super-reduced and parking set for EU members plus the UK, and standard VAT/GST rates for non-EU countries such as Switzerland, Norway, Canada, India, Japan, Australia, Singapore, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Turkey. Paid plans add historical rates by date and regional exceptions by postcode.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., DE, FR, ES). EL, XI, 3-letter codes and English country names are also accepted

params.name: date
params.description: Look up rate effective on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: postcode
params.description: Check for regional exceptions (e.g., Canary Islands, Ceuta)

vehiclefueleconomy.title: Vehicle Fuel Economy
vehiclefueleconomy.description: Vehicle Fuel Economy returns the EPA ratings of every car and light truck sold in the US since 1984, electric vehicles included. Search by make, model, year and fuel type to get city, highway and combined MPG (or MPGe), electric range, engine, drive and transmission. Paid plans add kWh per 100 miles, charge time at 240V, annual fuel cost, five-year savings, CO2 per mile and the EPA fuel economy, greenhouse gas and smog scores.

params.name: make
params.description: Vehicle make, for example Toyota, Ford or Tesla. Either make or model is required

params.name: model
params.description: Model name or the start of it, for example Camry or Model 3. Either make or model is required

params.name: year
params.description: Model year, 1984 or later

params.name: fuelType
params.description: Only vehicles with this powertrain

params.name: limit
params.description: Vehicles per page, 1-50

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to return, starting at 1

vindecoder.title: VIN Decoder
vindecoder.description: VIN Decoder turns a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number into the vehicle it identifies. Returns make, model, year, trim, body class and manufacturer, plus engine specifications, plant of manufacture, and the safety equipment fitted to that specific build. Optionally adds every safety recall issued for that vehicle and its NHTSA 5-star crash-test rating.

params.name: vin
params.description: The Vehicle Identification Number to decode. Partial VINs are accepted and decode as far as the available characters allow.

params.name: recalls
params.description: Add the safety recalls NHTSA has issued for this vehicle's make, model and year.

params.name: safetyRating
params.description: Add the NHTSA 5-star crash-test rating for the closest tested version of this vehicle.

params.name: fuelEconomy
params.description: Add EPA fuel economy (city, highway and combined MPG, or MPGe for electric) for the matching versions of this vehicle.

visarequirements.title: Visa Requirements
visarequirements.description: Visa Requirements tells you what a passport holder needs to enter another country: no visa, an electronic travel authorization, an eVisa, a visa on arrival, a visa arranged in advance, or entry restricted. Paid plans add the allowed stay in days, every alternative route (an eVisa or a visa on arrival, say), a link to the official government portal for ETAs and eVisas, per-category counts for a passport and its full destination list.

params.name: passport
params.description: The passport's country: a two-letter ISO code such as US, an English name such as United States, UK for the United Kingdom, or a passport MRZ code such as D or GBR

params.name: destination
params.description: The destination country or territory: a two-letter ISO code such as JP, an English name such as Japan, or UK for the United Kingdom

vowelcounter.title: Vowel Counter
vowelcounter.description: Vowel Counter analyzes text to count vowels and consonants, providing detailed breakdowns and percentages for linguistic analysis.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to analyze (max 50,000 characters)

vpndetector.title: VPN Proxy Detector
vpndetector.description: VPN Proxy Detector checks any IP address to detect active VPN connections and cloud datacenter hosting. Lookups return boolean flags for VPN and datacenter status plus the verification date, with paid tiers adding Tor detection and risk levels.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address you want to check for VPN usage

weatheralerts.title: Weather Alerts
weatheralerts.description: Weather Alerts returns the severe weather warnings, watches and advisories in effect right now for any point or state in the United States, straight from the National Weather Service. Each alert names the event, how severe and urgent it is, the area covered, when it starts and ends, and what to do.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the location to check. Send with lon

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the location to check. Send with lat

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter US state or territory code (e.g., MO), or the full state name (e.g., Missouri, Puerto Rico), for every alert in effect across it. Used when lat and lon are not sent

weatherforecast.title: Weather
weatherforecast.description: Weather is a current weather API that reports conditions for any city name or zip code: real-time temperature and wind speed with compass direction, in both metric and imperial units, with the location's coordinates, time zone and local time, day or night, and a UV risk level. Paid plans add a 7-day forecast with daily highs, lows, rain chance and conditions for the week ahead, and an optional hourly forecast.

params.name: city
params.description: The city for which you want to get the current weather (e.g., San Francisco). A name shared by several places resolves to the best-known one (London is London, UK); add a state, province or country after a comma to pick another (e.g., Portland, Maine or London, Ontario). Korean and Japanese names with an administrative suffix (Seongnam-si, Shinjuku-ku) resolve too

params.name: forecast
params.description: Included by default. Set to false to omit the 7-day forecast and return current conditions only.

params.name: hourly
params.description: Set to true to add an hourly forecast: every hour from now through the end of the 7-day window.

weatherseasons.title: Weather Seasons
weatherseasons.description: Weather Seasons calculates astronomical solstice and equinox dates for any target year. It provides exact timestamps and reference timezones for the March and September equinoxes and the June and December solstices.

params.name: year
params.description: The year to get the dates of the solstice and equinox; defaults to the current year (UTC)

webimagescraper.title: Website Images Scraper
webimagescraper.description: Website Images Scraper is an image scraper API that extracts image URLs and hosting domains from any web page. Send a page URL to retrieve direct image sources, breakdown counts for internal versus external assets, and unique hosting domains.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website you want to scrape images from (a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com; https:// is assumed when no scheme is given)

params.name: maxlinks
params.description: The limit of image URLs returned from your query

params.name: includequery
params.description: Keep query strings on the scraped image URLs instead of trimming them

webpconverter.title: WebP Converter
webpconverter.description: WebP Converter transforms WebP images to classic formats like PNG and JPG, or converts other formats to WebP for better compression. Essential for handling modern web images.

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: Target format

params.name: quality
params.description: Output quality (applies to jpg/webp)

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum width in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Maximum height in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

webscreenshots.title: Website Screenshot
webscreenshots.description: Website Screenshot renders webpage screenshots from any URL as PNG, JPEG or WebP, with ads blocked and cookie notices dismissed. It returns a signed download link with an expiration timestamp, supporting custom viewport dimensions up to 3840 pixels wide, single-element capture by CSS selector, a capture delay, a page-load wait strategy and JPEG or WebP quality.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to capture the screenshot (a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com; https:// is assumed when no scheme is given)

params.name: type
params.description: The image format for the screenshot

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the screenshot in pixels (e.g., 1920). Must be between 100 and 3840

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the screenshot in pixels (e.g., 1080).  Must be between 100 and 3840

params.name: fullpage
params.description: Whether to capture the full page screenshot (true or false)

params.name: selector
params.description: CSS selector of a single element to capture instead of the viewport (e.g., #pricing). The first match is captured; a selector that matches nothing returns 400

params.name: delay
params.description: Milliseconds to wait after the page loads before capturing, for animations or late content. Between 0 and 5000

params.name: waituntil
params.description: When navigation counts as finished before capture: domcontentloaded (default, fastest), load (all resources), or networkidle (network quiet). A page that never settles is captured as parsed

params.name: quality
params.description: Compression quality from 1 to 100. Applies only when type is jpeg or webp

websitereadability.title: Website Readability
websitereadability.description: Website Readability analyzes live web pages to score their reading difficulty and educational grade level. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level, word count, sentence count, and estimated reading time.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to analyze

websitetopdf.title: Website to PDF
websitetopdf.description: Website to PDF renders any public web page into a PDF document from a submitted URL. It returns a temporary signed download link, unique filename, and expiration timestamp, with paid plans adding the page count, paper size, custom margins, landscape layout and background printing control.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website to convert to PDF; without a scheme, https:// is assumed

params.name: marginTop
params.description: The top margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: marginRight
params.description: The right margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: marginBottom
params.description: The bottom margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: marginLeft
params.description: The left margin of the PDF in inches from 0 to 4 (e.g., 0.4)

params.name: landscape
params.description: Set to true for landscape orientation

params.name: format
params.description: Paper size

params.name: printBackground
params.description: Print background colors and images; set false for an ink-saving document

websitetotext.title: Website to Text
websitetotext.description: Website to Text converts any webpage URL into plain text stripped of HTML tags. It returns the extracted body copy, page title, meta description, publication date, and detected language code.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website to convert to text; without a scheme, https:// is assumed

whoislookup.title: WHOIS Lookup
whoislookup.description: WHOIS Lookup is a domain WHOIS API that reads the registry's RDAP or WHOIS record for any domain and returns the registrar, creation and expiry dates, nameservers, EPP status codes explained in plain English, transfer-lock and privacy flags, the registrant country where it is published, and domain age in days and years.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain name for which you want to get the registration data (e.g., myspace.com)

wordladder.title: Word Ladder Generator
wordladder.description: Word Ladder Generator creates puzzles where players transform one word into another by changing one letter at a time, with each step forming a valid word.

params.name: start
params.description: Starting word (3-6 letters); must differ from end

params.name: end
params.description: Ending word (same length as start)

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level

params.name: count
params.description: Number of puzzles

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

wordlehelper.title: Wordle Helper
wordlehelper.description: Wordle Helper is a Wordle solver API that finds possible 5-letter word solutions based on known letter positions, letters in wrong positions, and eliminated letters.

params.name: green
params.description: Correct letters with positions (e.g., A1 means A at position 1)

params.name: yellow
params.description: Letters in word but wrong position (e.g., R2 means R not at position 2); each entry is a letter with an optional position 1-5

params.name: gray
params.description: Letters not in the word. A letter that is also green or yellow is capped at the number of times it is marked green or yellow, as in Wordle's duplicate-letter rule

params.name: pattern
params.description: Pattern with known letters (use _ for unknown)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of suggestions

wordopposite.title: Word Opposites
wordopposite.description: Word Opposites looks up direct antonyms for any single input term. Pass an English word to receive an array of contrasting and opposing words.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to get the opposites for

wordpronunciation.title: Word Pronunciation
wordpronunciation.description: Word Pronunciation is a pronunciation API that retrieves the phonetic pronunciation of any English word in ARPAbet format. Pass a word to receive its phonetic transcription for speech synthesis, dictionaries, or language tools.

params.name: word
params.description: The word to get the pronunciation of

wordrhymes.title: Rhyming Words
wordrhymes.description: Rhyming Words finds matching rhymes for any query word, returning a list of rhyming words and a total match count. Paid plans can adjust the maximum number of rhymes returned.

params.name: word
params.description: The word for which you want to get rhyming words

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of word rhymes returned

wordscramble.title: Word Scramble Generator
wordscramble.description: Word Scramble Generator is a scramble word API that creates puzzles where players unscramble letters to form words, returning each scrambled sequence with its answer and letter count.

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level (affects word length)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of puzzles

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

wordsearch.title: Word Search Generator
wordsearch.description: Word Search Generator is a word search API that creates customizable word search puzzles with configurable grid size, word placement, and difficulty levels.

params.name: words
params.description: Array of words to hide in the puzzle (3-20 words), in Latin, Cyrillic or Greek letters; the grid is filled from the same alphabet

params.name: size
params.description: Grid size

params.name: difficulty
params.description: Difficulty level (affects word directions)

params.name: image
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable puzzle image

params.name: solutionImage
params.description: Set to true to generate a downloadable solution image

wordstonumbers.title: Words to Numbers
