wordstonumbers.description: Words to Numbers converts spelled-out number phrases into numeric digits. Pass written words to receive the calculated number, formatted English notation, and total digit counts.

params.name: words
params.description: The words to convert to numbers, e.g. two hundred forty-five, minus seven, three point five or 2 million
params.example: seven thousand six hundred and twenty

workingdays.title: Working Days
workingdays.description: Working Days is a working days and business days API that counts the working days and non-working days for any country and month. Pass a two-letter country code and month number to get total counts, working date lists, and non-working days marked with holiday names. On paid plans, add a state or region for regional holidays, set a custom weekend, count between any two dates, or add business days to a date.

params.name: country
params.description: The 2-letter country code you want to get the number of working days for

params.name: month
params.description: The month you want to get the number of working days for

params.name: year
params.description: The year you want to get the number of working days for; defaults to the current year

params.name: region
params.description: Optional state or region code within the country for regional public holidays (e.g. CA for California, BY for Bavaria)

params.name: weekend
params.description: Comma-separated weekend days as names or numbers 0-6 (Sunday=0), or none. Defaults to the country's weekend (fri,sat for SA, IL, EG and other Gulf/MENA countries; fri for IR; sat,sun elsewhere)

params.name: start
params.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). With end, counts working days across that range (up to 366 days, inclusive) instead of a month. With addDays, the date to count from (defaults to today)

params.name: end
params.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Used with start

params.name: addDays
params.description: Number of working days to add to start (negative to subtract). The start date itself is not counted. Returns resultDate plus the days it stepped over

worldholidays.title: World Holidays
worldholidays.description: World Holidays lists public holidays and observances for any two-letter country code, optionally for a state or region. It returns holiday dates, local and English names, day of week, event types and substitute-day flags, and can check whether a single date is a holiday.

params.name: country
params.description: The country to get holidays for: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US or GB. Alpha-3 codes (USA, DEU), English country names (Germany) and UK are also accepted

params.name: year
params.description: The year for which you want to get the holidays

params.name: region
params.description: State or region code (e.g. BY, CA or US-CA) to include regional holidays

params.name: type
params.description: Only return these holiday types, comma-separated: public, bank, school, optional, observance

params.name: date
params.description: Check a single date (YYYY-MM-DD); returns isHoliday and only the holidays on that day. Overrides year

worldtime.title: World Time
worldtime.description: World Time looks up the current local time, date, and timezone for any city, or for any latitude and longitude. Search by city name to get matching locations with country codes, IANA timezone identifiers, UTC offsets, and formatted times in 12-hour, 24-hour, and ISO 8601 formats.

params.name: city
params.description: The city name for which you want to get the current time (e.g., New York). Add a state, province or country after a comma to narrow it (e.g., Portland, Maine or London, UK). Matches are ordered with the best-known city first. Smaller cities (Plano, TX; Noida) and common former or local names (Bangalore, Bombay, Saigon, NYC, Munchen) are found too

xmltojson.title: XML to JSON
xmltojson.description: XML to JSON is an XML to JSON converter API that turns raw XML strings into structured JSON objects. Send any valid XML payload to receive an organized JSON tree preserving tags, attributes, and child elements.

params.name: xml
params.description: The XML content to convert to JSON

zipcodes.title: Zip Codes Lookup
zipcodes.description: Zip Codes Lookup finds all postal codes within a US city or resolves a five-digit ZIP code to its city and state. Every ZIP also returns its primary county. Paid plans add the county and state FIPS codes, every county a ZIP crosses with its land share, the IANA time zone, geographic coordinates and the distance from the ZIP to a second ZIP.

params.name: zip
params.description: The US ZIP code to look up. ZIP+4 (64082-1234) and ZIPs that lost their leading zero in a spreadsheet (2134 for 02134) are accepted

params.name: distanceTo
params.description: A second US ZIP code; adds a distance object with the straight-line distance between the two ZIP centroids

zipdemographics.title: ZIP Demographics
zipdemographics.description: ZIP Demographics is a demographic data API for any US ZIP code, built on the US Census American Community Survey. Every plan gets total population and median household income, while paid plans add age, per-capita income, education, housing, employment, and racial composition.

params.name: zip
params.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (ZIP+4 like 78701-1234 and ZIPs whose leading zero a spreadsheet dropped, like 2108, are accepted)
